description_html:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Join Back Market's dynamic Seller Success team as the driving force behind our seller ecosystem! As Europe's leading refurbished electronics marketplace, we're revolutionizing how businesses connect with millions of customers across the EU, the UK and the US.

As a Seller Activation Intern (Onboarding & Seller Support), you'll be at the heart of our growth strategy, transforming thousands of potential sellers into thriving Back Market partners. You'll master the art of business prioritization, relationship building, and data-driven decision making while gaining hands-on experience in one of Europe's fastest-growing tech companies.

This isn't just about processing applications – you'll be identifying high-potential business opportunities, strategically prioritizing sellers based on market potential, and directly impacting our marketplace expansion across Europe and the United States. At the same time, you'll play a hands-on role in improving how we work — collaborating with cross-functional teams to spot inefficiencies in our seller activation processes and helping design better, more scalable solutions.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

  • Strategic Seller Management: Navigate through our extensive database of thousands of potential sellers, qualifying and prioritizing them based on business potential and strategic fit

  • Business Development: Provide professional consultation and support via Salesforce, guiding sellers through our comprehensive onboarding journey from initial sign-up to successful activation

  • Data-Driven Prioritization: Leverage Excel and Salesforce to analyze seller profiles, create strategic reports, and identify the most promising business opportunities

  • Projects : Take ownership of improvement projects end to end. You'll get your hands dirty identifying pain points, spotting repetitive tasks ripe for automation, and driving solutions from idea to implementation with the help of your manager — not just flagging issues, but fixing them.

  • International Impact: Communicate directly with sellers across Europe and the US, building strong professional relationships that drive business growth

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

  • Seeking a 6-month full-time internship (Gap Year or End of Studies welcome)

  • Fluent English - you'll be the voice of Back Market to international sellers

  • Excel proficiency including pivot tables and data analysis capabilities

  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail - you'll manage high-volume, process-intensive workflows

  • Passionate about business development/sales with a keen eye for identifying opportunities

  • Structured approach to work with ability to prioritize effectively in fast-paced environments

Bonus Points:

  • French language skills

  • Salesforce experience or CRM familiarity

  • Previous commercial or e-commerce experience

  • Proactive mindset with initiative for process improvements

  • Additional European languages

Ideal Profile: We're looking for ambitious, friendly yet professional students who are genuinely excited about sales, business development, and e-commerce — and who don't just want to observe, but to build. The ideal candidate is curious about how processes work, quick to spot inefficiencies, and motivated to own solutions from start to finish. Whether you're taking a gap year or completing your studies, what matters most is your motivation, business acumen, and eagerness to make a real impact.

ABOUT THE INTERNSHIP ℹ️

  • Starting date: January 2027

  • Duration: 6 months (until June 2027)

  • Schedule: Full-time (35H/week)

  • Location: Paris, France

  • Contract: Internship agreement from your French school required

RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

  • Skills fit interview with the direct manager (Reviewing the job description and missions, your CV and past experiences/projects)

  • Video-call HR Interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist

  • Cultural fit interview with another person in the team

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

Compensation: €1.2K – €1.4K per month

  • • Paris-based Internship salary range, depending on study level €1.2K – €1.4K per month

From pricing and customer lifecycle to customer satisfaction and automation, the team uses data to monitor performance, identify opportunities, and drive high-impact decisions across the business.

 

As a Business Analyst Intern in the Trade-In team, you will support both strategic analysis and day-to-day operations. You will work on extracting, modeling, and visualizing data, improving tools and dashboards, and helping the team better understand performance drivers. This is a hands-on internship with strong exposure to business topics, operational processes, and automation initiatives, ideal for someone who wants to combine analytics with real business impact.

  • 80% - Business & Data Analysis

    • Support the team with data extraction, manipulation, analysis, modeling, and visualization needs.

    • Help maintain, update, and improve circularity performance and operations tools, including reports, trackers, dashboards, alerting processes, and operational processes based on automated queries.

    • Assist the team in monitoring and analyzing circularity services performance based on key performance indicators on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis.

    • Contribute to challenging KPIs and tools, and propose ideas to improve the efficiency and accuracy of tracking and analysis.

    • Participate in root cause analyses to better understand performance drivers and identify potential levers for sustainable improvement.

    • Support ad hoc analyses to explore and size opportunities to grow the business and/or increase profitability. Assist the team in modeling and sizing project impact, and help ensure projects and processes are supported by clean, reliable data.

    • Help maintain and update documentation about circularity data, including access to key databases, key queries, methodologies, important analyses, as well as onboarding and training materials.

  • 20% - Operations & Automation

    • Support the team with daily operational processes, such as alerts and incidents related to shipping, pricing, risks, and other topics, while helping identify opportunities to improve and automate them.

    • Contribute to automation initiatives leveraging AI, such as reporting, analysis, and task automation.

  • You are currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Business, Management, Engineering, or an equivalent field, with a specialization in data and analytics based in Barcelona and your school can provide an internship agreement

  • You are comfortable using SQL, Google Sheets, Tableau, or similar data visualization tools

  • You have strong mathematical skills and are able to build complex models

  • You can communicate clearly and make technical work accessible to non-technical audiences

  • You are autonomous and able to manage multiple tasks and projects at the same time

  • You enjoy hands-on problem solving and are not afraid to dive into operational topics

  • Team spirit is essential for you, and you are someone people enjoy working with

  • You are 100% comfortable in spoken and written English, as this is required for the role

  • Bonus points if you have experience with process automation tools such as Workato or AI agent creation

  • Bonus points if you already have advanced SQL and Tableau experience in a business environment

  • Bonus points if you have worked with Google Analytics, Data Studio, or Amplitude

  • Bonus points if you speak additional languages such as French, German, Spanish, or Italian

  • You are willing to learn and grow in a fast-paced environment

title: Implementation Consultant

description_html:
monday.com is the AI work platform powering the most ambitious teams. 250,000+ customers across departments use us to bring people, workflows, and AI agents together on one flexible platform where AI doesn't just assist, it executes. We move fast, build things that matter, and foster an ownership-driven culture where you're empowered to shape how organisations work and outpace their competition.

Our team is growing and we are looking for an Implementation Consultant (Forward Deployed Consultant) to join our Professional Services team! In this role, you will train, advise and consult, and build with customers to optimise their use of the monday.com AI work platform during the course of an AI transformation, implementation, or ongoing managed services engagement. You will design and build the AI-native solutions that get them there, from intelligent workflows and agents to the automations and reporting their business relies on. You will run engagements both independently and as a part of a delivery team collaborating with deployment strategists and engineers.

Please note that this is a hybrid position with three days/week in our Paris office.

About the Role

  • Lead AI transformation and implementation engagements for monday.com customers, designing and building tailored solutions using agents, vibe-coded applications, and other advanced capabilities of the monday AI work platform.

  • Build strong relationships with client stakeholders, running the discovery that uncovers their desired business outcomes, and ensure successful adoption of the solutions you deliver across their organization.

  • Consult on business process design, mapping how work moves through a customer's organization and recommending the process changes that should be made before the solution is built.

  • Design sophisticated workflows and relational data structures within the monday.com platform to solve complex business cases, partnering with technical resources for data conversions, integrations, and agentic engineering.

  • Actively leverage monday AI and external Generative/Agentic AI tools to accelerate solution design, automate complex business logic, and deliver intelligent workflows for our customers.

  • Act as the project manager on standalone engagements, building and executing on project plans that ensure deliverables stay on-time and on-budget, and delivering defined scope alongside a deployment strategist on larger ones.

  • Run online webinars, training sessions, consultations, and one-on-one demos that show customers how our product capabilities translate into business value.

  • Produce the documentation, walkthroughs, and exit artifacts for your engagements that allow customers to operate, maintain, and extend what you built independently.

  • Represent the voice of the customer by advocating for their needs and influencing the product development roadmap.

  • Contribute the patterns and reusable assets you develop in the field back to our shared asset library.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience as a forward deployed consultant, implementation consultant, solutions consultant, or technical project manager in enterprise software.

  • Experience leading software implementation or managed services projects that required hands-on build and system configuration in project management, CRM, service desk, or collaborative work management software.

  • Fluency in Generative and Agentic AI tools, with a strong understanding of how to leverage AI in streamlining work productivity and building intelligent workflows and agents.

  • Familiarity with what keeps AI reliable in production, including human review, checking outputs, and knowing when a deterministic automation is the better answer.

  • Strong problem solving skills, rooted in computational thinking, systems design, and an understanding of relational data structures.

  • Business process design and consulting experience, with the business acumen to frame an engagement around customer outcomes, and the judgment to read the implicit problem behind an explicit request.

  • Working knowledge of integration platforms (make.com, Zapier) sufficient to configure lightweight integrations yourself, with foundational knowledge of APIs (GraphQL) and MCP a plus.

  • Strong customer-facing and presentation skills with the ability to establish credibility with client stakeholders and executives, and to clearly articulate technical topics to a non-technical audience.

  • Ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies across a changing set of customers and industries.

  • Detail-oriented with strong project management skills, comfortable running engagements independently and working across several at once.

  • Superb written and verbal communication skills, with a positive attitude, empathy, high energy, and the ability to take initiative and adapt.

  • BA or BS degree preferred.


Please note that this role is hybrid.

Visa sponsorship for this role is currently not available.

El Puesto

Serás responsable de impulsar el crecimiento comercial de nuestras soluciones ERP, software de gestión, movilidad, planificación, RR. HH. e Inteligencia Artificial en clientes nuevos y existentes. Trabajarás en un entorno B2B tecnológico, con ciclos de venta consultivos y clientes de tamaño medio y grande, colaborando estrechamente con los equipos de producto, consultoría, marketing y dirección.

Inteligencia Artificial: una parte importante de tu trabajo
En Freematica estamos incorporando la IA como una nueva capa de valor sobre nuestras soluciones y también como herramienta para transformar nuestra propia forma de trabajar.

Por ello, buscamos una persona que tenga interés real por la Inteligencia Artificial y sea capaz de incorporarla a su actividad comercial.

Utilizarás herramientas de IA para:

  • Mejorar la prospección y segmentación de cuentas
  • Preparar reuniones y analizar información de clientes
  • Identificar necesidades y oportunidades de negocio
  • Personalizar mensajes y propuestas comerciales
  • Analizar conversaciones, oportunidades y pipeline
  • Automatizar tareas comerciales y administrativas
  • Generar contenidos y argumentarios comerciales
  • Obtener insights a partir de datos y actividad comercial
  • Explorar nuevos casos de uso de IA aplicables a nuestros clientes y sectores
No buscamos necesariamente un perfil técnico de IA. Buscamos una persona con curiosidad, criterio y capacidad para entender cómo aplicar la tecnología y la IA para conseguir mejores resultados comerciales y aportar más valor al cliente.


Responsabilidades

  • Dominar rápidamente nuestro producto: comprender en profundidad nuestras soluciones, módulos, arquitectura básica y principales casos de uso para poder mantener conversaciones de valor tanto con perfiles de negocio como técnicos
  • Venta consultiva B2B: analizar los procesos, necesidades y retos del cliente, entender su modelo operativo y proponer la solución tecnológica que mejor responda a sus objetivos
  • Prospección y generación de negocio: identificar empresas objetivo, detectar oportunidades, realizar contactos iniciales, cualificar leads y desarrollar nuevas cuentas
  • Discovery y análisis de necesidades: preparar y dirigir reuniones de descubrimiento, identificar pain points, interlocutores, procesos, necesidades y criterios de decisión
  • Presentaciones y demos comerciales: presentar nuestras soluciones de forma orientada al negocio, adaptando el discurso a cada sector y perfil interlocutor
  • Diseño y seguimiento del proceso comercial: trabajar con un proceso estructurado y un pipeline definido: prospección → cualificación → discovery → demo → propuesta → negociación → cierre
  • Gestión rigurosa del CRM: mantener Salesforce actualizado, registrar actividad, próximos pasos, probabilidad de cierre, interlocutores y cualquier información relevante de las oportunidades
  • Forecast comercial: realizar previsiones de ventas rigurosas, identificar riesgos y mantener actualizado el estado real de cada oportunidad
  • Elaboración de propuestas a medida: coordinarte con los equipos de producto, consultoría y tecnología para transformar las necesidades detectadas en propuestas claras, viables y competitivas
  • Gestión de cuentas y crecimiento: detectar oportunidades de ampliación, nuevas soluciones, servicios y funcionalidades dentro de nuestra base instalada


Requisitos

  • Experiencia previa de 4-6 años o más en venta consultiva B2B de tecnología, preferiblemente en ERP, software de gestión empresarial, SaaS, Cloud, IT o soluciones digitales
  • Alta capacidad de aprendizaje técnico: comodidad trabajando con productos complejos y capacidad para traducir funcionalidades tecnológicas a beneficios de negocio
  • Experiencia en procesos de venta consultiva y ciclos comerciales B2B
  • Mentalidad de proceso y orientación a métricas
  • Experiencia trabajando con CRM (preferiblemente Salesforce), pipeline, forecast y metodologías comerciales estructuradas
  • Rigor en el seguimiento de oportunidades y reporting
  • Orientación a resultados y al cierre, manteniendo una visión de relación a largo plazo con el cliente
  • Capacidad para mantener conversaciones con diferentes interlocutores: dirección, operaciones, RR. HH., administración, IT, etc.
  • Autonomía y proactividad:
    • Capacidad para organizar tu agenda y priorizar cuentas
    • Iniciativa para generar oportunidades y abrir nuevas puertas
    • Capacidad para tomar decisiones y avanzar sin supervisión constante
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, presentación y negociación
  • Interés y conocimientos prácticos en Inteligencia Artificial y herramientas de productividad basadas en IA
  • Residencia en España y disponibilidad para desplazamientos puntuales a clientes y oficinas
Se valorará muy positivamente
  • Formación en áreas tecnológicas, empresariales o similares: Ingeniería, ADE, Economía, Informática, etc.
  • Experiencia previa en software empresarial, ERP o SaaS B2B
  • Experiencia en proyectos de transformación digital o implantación de soluciones de gestión
  • Conocimiento de los sectores de Limpieza, Facility, Seguridad, Servicios, Outsourcing o Instalaciones, o sectores con modelos operativos similares
  • Experiencia utilizando herramientas de IA generativa como ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude u otras herramientas similares aplicadas al trabajo diario
  • Conocimientos sobre automatización de procesos, agentes de IA, análisis de datos o aplicación de IA a procesos empresariales
  • Experiencia trabajando con equipos de Marketing y Product
  • Conocimiento de metodologías de venta consultiva y frameworks comerciales
  • Experiencia con Salesforce u otros CRM
  • Nivel de inglés suficiente para trabajar con documentación técnica y tecnológica


Tus ventajas

  • Incorporarte a una compañía sólida, con más de 28 años desarrollando software propio de gestión empresarial y una base estable de clientes en toda España
  • Trabajar con un producto tecnológico real, complejo y con un amplio recorrido de evolución
  • Participar en un momento especialmente interesante de transformación de nuestro producto, con el desarrollo de nuevas soluciones basadas en movilidad, automatización e Inteligencia Artificial
  • Formar parte de un equipo técnico y especializado donde tu opinión puede influir tanto en el producto como en la estrategia comercial
  • Oportunidad real de crecimiento profesional en el área comercial y de desarrollo de negocio
  • Entorno donde se valoran la iniciativa, la autonomía, el rigor y la capacidad de aportar
  • Acompañamiento inicial para que puedas conocer nuestro producto, nuestros sectores y nuestra metodología comercial
  • Condiciones competitivas acordes a la experiencia aportada, con fijo + variable por objetivos


Esperamos recibir su solicitud.

Más que un perfil que simplemente "venda software", buscamos a una persona que quiera convertirse en referente comercial de nuestras soluciones. Alguien capaz de sentarse con un cliente, entender cómo funciona su negocio, detectar dónde están sus problemas, explicar cómo puede ayudar la tecnología y construir una propuesta que tenga sentido tanto operativa como económicamente.Y, especialmente, alguien que entienda que la IA no es solo una tecnología más, sino una nueva forma de trabajar, vender y aportar valor a nuestros clientes.Si te motiva vender soluciones tecnológicas complejas, disfrutas entendiendo el negocio del cliente, tienes curiosidad por la tecnología y la IA y te gusta construir relaciones comerciales basadas en confianza, conocimiento y resultados, nos encantará conocerte.Envíanos tu CV y cuéntanos brevemente qué proyectos de venta consultiva tecnológica has liderado, qué tipo de soluciones has vendido y cómo estás utilizando actualmente la IA en tu trabajo.

title: Performance Marketing Manager, Paid Search
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Angi
description_html:
For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well.

For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you.

Angi at a glance:

  • Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021

  • Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide

  • Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

About the role:

As the Paid Search Marketing Manager for the UK market, you will play a key role in driving growth and profitability through expertly managed paid search campaigns. You will have the opportunity to work on high-impact initiatives, shaping how we connect with both sides of our marketplace - homeowners and tradespeople. We are looking for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment and is committed to consistently improving performance while exploring new opportunities to innovate and expand. This role reports to a Paid Search Director.

What you’ll do:

  • Steward the day-to-day management and optimization of Google Ads and Microsoft Ads campaigns, ensuring they deliver maximum profitability.

  • Conduct in-depth keyword research, running ad copy tests, and analyzing performance to continually improve profitability and ROAS.

  • Partner with our Product and Analytics teams to implement advanced reporting and actionable insights.

  • Stay ahead of the curve by monitoring industry trends, testing new strategies, and exploring untapped opportunities for paid search growth.

  • Leverage AI tools and agents (e.g. Claude-based workflows, Google Ads Scripts automation) for campaign monitoring, reporting, and anomaly detection to work more efficiently and surface insights faster.

This role gives you the chance to make a real impact while working in an environment that encourages innovation and data-driven experimentation. Your contributions will directly shape the success of our paid marketing efforts in a key European market.

Who you are:

  • 2-4 years of experience in Paid Search Marketing, specifically with Google Ads and Microsoft Ads.

  • Experience with budget management, bid optimization, and performance tracking.

  • Analytical mindset with a focus on data-driven decision-making.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with display or video advertising as a supplementary skill.

  • Experience with marketplace management

  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) techniques.

  • Comfort working with AI tools and agents (e.g. Claude, automation scripts) to accelerate reporting and analysis — a definite plus, though not required.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • The salary band for this position ranges from £50,000 - 65,000, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

  • Hybrid work environment and home office set-up allowance

  • Temporary work from abroad policy

  • Regular team and social events

title: Solutions Architect, Voice - London
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Decagon
description_html:
About Decagon

Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.

Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.

We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.

We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.

About the Role

Decagon is seeking a Solutions Architect – Voice, a technical hire who will define how enterprises deploy Decagon's AI agents into live voice and contact center environments. This role sits at the intersection of pre-sales engineering, telephony architecture, and enterprise contact center strategy. You will act as a trusted advisor to enterprise prospects and customers, guiding them through complex, ambiguous voice deployment conversations—from SIP trunking and call routing to media handling and real-time transcription—ensuring Decagon integrates seamlessly into their existing contact center platforms while meeting latency, reliability, and compliance requirements.

As an early hire in this function, you will define best practices for voice deployment solutioning, partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Engineering, and set the standard for how Decagon engages with enterprises running mission-critical contact center operations. You will establish technical credibility with stakeholders across the C-suite, telephony and network teams, contact center operations, and CX leadership.

In this role, you will

  • Partner with Account Executives to discover, qualify, and design voice deployment solutions that address customer telephony constraints and deliver measurable containment and CX outcomes.

  • Navigate ambiguous conversations about a customer's contact center landscape, translating diverse environments (Genesys Cloud CX & Engage, Amazon Connect, Cisco UCCE/CVP, Google CCAI) into clear integration and deployment strategies for Decagon's voice platform.

  • Design SIP integration approaches—BYOC trunking, REFER-based transfer, header propagation, and media/streaming paths (Websockets, Audio Connector, External Voice Transfer)—tailored to each customer's topology and security posture.

  • Diagnose complex, multi-leg call flows down to the packet level, and establish repeatable methods for tracing and resolving SIP and media issues in production.

  • Establish scalable pre-sales processes, deployment playbooks, and reusable reference architectures to support growth.

Your background looks something like this

  • 8–10+ years in customer-facing technical roles (Solutions Architect, Solutions Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Product Manager) with a focus on voice, telephony, or contact center platforms.

  • Deep fluency in enterprise contact center platforms—Genesys, Amazon Connect, Cisco, or Google CCAI—and the SIP/telephony fundamentals underneath them (trunking, transfer semantics, codecs, SRTP, DTMF).

  • Hands-on experience with CPaaS infrastructure such as Twilio or Telnyx, including BYOC configuration and programmable voice.

  • Demonstrated success navigating ambiguous technical conversations with enterprise customers, asking the right discovery questions, and collaborating through uncertainty.

  • Strong ability to engage diverse stakeholders—from network engineers to CX and contact center leaders—and translate voice requirements into actionable deployment strategies.

Even better if you have

  • 2+ years selling or architecting AI/ML or conversational voice solutions in enterprise environments.

  • Experience in a high-growth startup where you built pre-sales practices from the ground up.

  • Hands-on packet-level SIP diagnostics experience (pcap analysis, Wireshark/Scapy) and comfort reading raw signaling.

  • Familiarity with real-time speech stacks (STT/TTS), call recording and compliance patterns (SIPREC), and multi-leg call correlation.

Benefits

We proudly offer the following benefits for our full-time employees:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life Insurance and Disability Benefits

  • Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)

  • Parental Leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work-life balance

  • Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best

  • Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave)

These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.

Compensation: £144.3K – £216.4K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission

title: Senior Agent Product Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Decagon
description_html:
About Decagon

Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.

Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.

We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.

We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.

About the Team

When a Fortune 500 C-suite brings in Decagon, they are not buying a support tool. They are buying a transformation of how their customers experience their brand, end to end. Agent Product Managers are the people they trust to make that transformation real.

Your counterpart is the C-suite, and what they are asking you to transform is their entire customer experience. You define the roadmap, the frameworks, and the decision-making models that make a top-down transformation feel safe to bet on. You hold that relationship from the first pre-sales conversation through the life of the account.

The work compounds in a way most roles don't. Every flagship deployment you lead feeds directly into our playbooks and raises the quality of every build that follows. Hard-won lessons on your accounts become leverage across the whole company, and the IP you create outlives any single agent.

These are the largest, most complex enterprises in the market. The ones that require deep customization, real judgment, and a partner who can operate at the highest level. This is not a standardized implementation role, and it is not an account management or customer success role.

 

About the Role

This role owns the successful delivery, adoption, and expansion of AI solutions for Decagon's customers, serving as the primary technical and strategic owner. You earn trust with the customer's leadership team, scope a solution that solves their problems, and then build the working AI agent. You are the direct owner for each account's agents end-to-end, partnering with our Strategic Account Directors, Agent Strategy Managers and Forward Deployed Engineers to scale the agent in production and grow it into a core part of how the customer's company runs.

It is a rare combination: the executive influence of a top strategy consulting leader, the instincts of a product builder, and the ownership of a founder. If you have ever wanted to build the solution instead of hand off the recommendation, this role was designed for you. You own the outcome end to end, on the highest-stakes accounts in the market, with all of Decagon's cross-functional teams behind you.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You are trusted to make high-stakes decisions independently and own outcomes, gaining leverage by directing forward deployed engineers and partner teams who own a share of the execution.

 

In this role, you will

  • Own the technical win on Decagon's largest strategic opportunities, partnering with Sales, Solutions Engineers and Forward-deployed engineers to build working AI agents that turn sophisticated, skeptical buyers into signed customers.

  • Serve as the executive partner to the C-suite of Fortune 500 companies, defining and driving their AI transformation roadmap and owning the relationship from first conversation through production and expansion.

  • Design, build, and optimize enterprise-grade AI agents in production, going deep on each customer's workflows, pain points, and goals.

  • Turn the frameworks and playbooks you develop into reusable assets that scale across accounts and feed directly into Decagon's product roadmap.

  • Direct Forward-deployed engineers and partner teams to deliver at scale while you stay accountable for the outcome.

  • Run tight feedback loops into Product and Engineering, shaping the product based on what you learn on the front lines of our most demanding deployments.

     

Your background looks something like this

  • 6+ years of experience owning ambiguous, high-stakes outcomes and earning the trust of senior executives. This includes engagement managers, project leaders, and senior managers from top consulting firms, as well as product managers, founders, and forward-deployed or solutions roles at high-growth technology companies.

  • A builder's instinct. You want to design and build the actual solution, not just diagnose the problem or manage someone else who builds it.

  • Strong technical acumen. You can understand and shape AI agent designs and hold your own in a technical conversation with both engineers and executives.

  • Executive presence and a track record of becoming a trusted advisor to senior decision-makers at large, complex organizations.

  • Comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where you shape the solution as much as you implement it.

     

Even better

  • A Computer Science, Engineering, or Math degree, or equivalent hands-on technical experience.

  • An MBA, or equivalent experience at the intersection of business strategy and technology, is a plus.

  • Experience selling, deploying, or advising on enterprise software or transformation programs at the Fortune 500 level.

Compensation

£145k – £180K + Offers Equity

Benefits

We proudly offer the following benefits for our full-time employees:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life Insurance and Disability Benefits

  • Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)

  • Parental Leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work-life balance

  • Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best

  • Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave)

These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.

title: Sr. Creative Designer (Performance Marketing) - Static & Motion
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Kraken
description_html:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

 

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Kraken's Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, static and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

 

The opportunity

As our Senior Performance Creative, you concept, produce and ship paid creative for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Paid static is the center of the role, but we're hiring a hybrid rather than a specialist: this means you also ideate and create performance video and treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot.

 

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and automation leadership: you set the bar for paid static on the team, work with AI enabled processes, collaborate closely with other Krakenites in and outside the team, and are the person others come to with performance creative questions.

  • Own paid static for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.

  • Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform's specs and native feel.

  • Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets, from 9:16 sound-on to static-adjacent 1:1 and 4:5.

  • Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video and imagery, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn't.

  • Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.

  • Version and localize at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you'll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets.

  • Build creative that's designed to be tested. Performance Marketing owns test design, cadence and readouts. You own the creative response: reading the results, forming a point of view on why a variant won, and turning that into the next round of hooks, concepts and cuts.

  • Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea.

  • Hold a high craft bar on your own work and keep your files clean enough for other people to build on.

     

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years in performance creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

  • A portfolio that proves it, submitted with your application. Paid static above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you're able to share it. Include two or three full video cuts, at least one AI-generated or AI-assisted piece with a short note on what was tooling and what was you, and one concept you tested where you can talk us through what the data said and what you changed.

  • Layout, hierarchy, type and composition that hold up at thumbnail size, in feed, and in multiple languages.

  • Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.

  • Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut.

  • High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it.

  • Experience inside a structured creative testing program. You're fluent in the metrics your creative moves (thumb-stop rate, hook rate, CTR, CVR, CPA and ROAS), you can tell a real winner from low performers, and can translate test results into a creative decision.

  • Fluency in internet and meme culture, with comedic timing and an instinct for what's about to feel dated.

  • Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.

  • Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with layouts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements.

  • A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.

  • Figma and Adobe CC (After Effects, Premiere, Photoshop) as well as strong genAI skills

  • Curious about investing and crypto at a minimum, and able to make the space legible to others.

description_html:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We are seeking an experienced and driven MLRO to lead the financial crime compliance programmes across Payward Ltd (PWL) and Payward Services Ltd (PSL), two FCA-regulated UK entities within the Kraken Group. This is a senior role with end-to-end responsibility for the effectiveness of the firms’ anti-money laundering (AML), counter-terrorist financing (CTF), and sanctions controls.

You will provide strategic and operational leadership across all aspects of financial crime risk management. This includes maintaining a robust control framework, advising on risk treatment across products and clients, and overseeing the operation and continuous improvement of transaction monitoring and sanctions screening systems.

 
 

The opportunity

  • Oversight of the AML/CTF and sanctions compliance frameworks across PWL and PSL

  • Develop, implement and maintain the firm’s AML/CTF policies, controls and procedures, ensuring that any global policies, controls and procedures meet UK regulatory requirements

  • Oversight of transaction monitoring, internal SAR and external SAR/DAML reporting

  • Oversight of CDD, EDD, enhanced monitoring and sanctions screening processes for the UK

  • Approve all new high risk client relationships and all periodic review outcomes of existing HRCs

  • Maintain and regularly update the firms’ business-wide financial crime risk assessments

  • Provide expert advice on AML and sanctions compliance across the customer lifecycle, including onboarding, periodic review, and investigations

  • Coordinate internal assurance activity and support external audits and regulatory reviews of the financial crime framework

  • Deliver training and awareness programmes to ensure staff understand their financial crime responsibilities

  • Prepare regular reporting and MI for senior management, risk committees, and the board

  • Lead delivery of UK MLRO team monthly review of UK corporate clients

  • Produce an annual MLRO report to the Board of Directors that assesses the overall AML/CTF framework and highlights emerging risks and improvements planned

  • Review monthly compliance and AML MI in order to identify trends, issues and ensure appropriate mitigation / escalation to the Board where appropriate

  • Attend relevant Committee meetings and Board meetings, support Executive decision making, escalate AML program related issues

  • Lead on strategic AML framework initiatives/implementations (e.g. Travel Rule)

  • Horizon scanning - monitor regulatory developments and ensure timely updates to internal policies and procedures

  • Liaise with law enforcement and regulatory authorities as required:

    • Regular engagement with FCA supervisory team

    • PoC for NCA

    • Support LEAs with setting up accounts

 
 

What you bring

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF and financial crime compliance within a regulated financial services firm

  • Deep understanding of the UK Money Laundering Regulations, Proceeds of Crime Act, UK sanctions regime (OFSI), and relevant industry guidance (e.g. JMLSG)

  • Proven track record of operating or overseeing transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, and customer due diligence systems

  • Skilled in translating complex regulatory requirements into actionable policy and operational controls

  • Confident communicator, able to influence senior stakeholders and represent the firm in external engagements

  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and resilient — with the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and manage competing priorities

 
 

Nice to haves

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF and financial crime compliance within a regulated cryptoasset, e-money, or payments firm

title: Head of Exchange Infrastructure
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Kraken
description_html:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.


We're looking for a Head of Exchange Infrastructure to own the layer every Kraken product is built on: the matching engine, core infrastructure, third-party custody, the algo engine and the API engine. Kraken grew up as a set of vertically integrated products, each with its own engine and its own APIs. This role consolidates them into a single exchange stack that serves every product and every interface. You will lead a team of four to five product managers, partnered with an engineering manager. It is a senior, independent team, which means you get leverage quickly and you are expected to stay close to the work.

 

The opportunity

  • Own the product vision and roadmap for the exchange layer: matching engine, core infrastructure, third-party custody, algo engine and API engine

  • Lead and grow a team of four to five product managers, and set the bar for product craft across the layer

  • Lead the consolidation of multiple matching engines into one, starting with US derivatives, then international derivatives, then spot

  • Build interface-agnostic, so every product team and every interface can build on the same platform rather than their own

  • Define success metrics (p99 latency, throughput, uptime, resiliency) and hold teams accountable to them

  • Partner with engineering leaders across exchange and core infrastructure to sequence the migration without disrupting live markets

  • Partner with Risk and Credit Infrastructure so a client can hold one account and trade every product against it

  • Anticipate industry shifts and shape our platform to stay ahead

  • Align cross-functional teams (product, engineering, risk, compliance) around the exchange strategy

 

What you bring

  • Senior product leader with experience in exchange, trading, or high-performance platforms

  • Experience managing and developing product managers, on a team senior enough to run without you in the room

  • Happy to be a player-coach. This team is independent, so you will own roadmaps and write specs yourself at times, not only review them

  • Proven ability to set product vision and translate it into a long-term roadmap

  • Strong understanding of matching engine and market data architecture, and the tradeoffs low latency forces

  • Experience building platforms for internal customers, with the judgment to tell a platform from a series of bespoke builds

  • Excellent communication skills — can influence technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • A passion for crypto markets, market structure, and building the next generation of infrastructure

 

Nice to haves

  • Engineering background before moving into product, so you've built or operated high-performance systems yourself and not just specced them

  • Experience across both spot and derivatives venues, with the market structure differences that come with each

  • Time at a crypto exchange operating at comparable scale, volume and uptime expectations

  • Track record building platform roadmaps that interlock with adjacent product orgs rather than running in isolation

description_html:
About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates.

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

Your Role

Are you passionate about hospitality and eager to make a real difference for hoteliers? At RoomPriceGenie, we're on a mission to help hotels boost revenue and simplify their operations. Our young, dynamic team is spread across Europe, with offices in Mannheim, Germany, and Steinhausen, Switzerland—and we're looking for an energetic Sales Development Representative to join us in driving growth and innovation!

In this role, you'll be the first point of contact for potential clients, sparking interest in RoomPriceGenie and connecting qualified property owners with our Sales Managers for product demos. You’ll play a key role in expanding our reach and will have the opportunity to contribute to our fast-growing startup’s success.

What You'll Do:

  • Engage with prospects: Identify decision-makers, uncover key business challenges, and pitch RoomPriceGenie’s solutions to ignite interest.

  • Daily outreach: Make and track phone calls through Hubspot, connecting with new prospects and keeping track of your success.

  • Bring your insights: Use your local market knowledge to enhance our outbound marketing activities and connect with hotel owners in a meaningful way.

  • Stay ahead of industry trends: Keep up-to-date on the latest hospitality industry news, trends, and competitor offerings to add value in your conversations.

  • Collaborate with management: Help streamline and optimize the customer journey, bringing fresh ideas to make processes smoother and more efficient.

  • Shape the future: Influence how our young startup develops by trying out your own approaches and contributing innovative ideas.

Your Profile

  • Native English speaker with excellent communication skills.

  • Currently based in United Kingdom or in CET timezone.

  • Sales-driven with a natural aptitude for understanding customer needs.

  • Tech-savvy and excited by the latest technology trends.

  • Positive and outgoing: You’re empathetic, enthusiastic, and love connecting with people.

  • Active listener: You know how to uncover pain points and find meaningful ways to engage with prospects.

  • Organized and detail-oriented: You thrive in a fast-paced environment and can juggle multiple tasks with ease.

  • Team player: Success is sweeter when it’s achieved together, and you love contributing to team goals.

Nice to have

  • Additional European languages (Italian, French, or more!).

  • Experience in a SaaS or travel-tech company.

  • Hospitality industry experience or a passion for helping hotels.

  • Ability to work from our offices on a regular basis.

What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie 💪

At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together.

Here’s what you can expect when you become part of our Genie family:

  • Remote-First Model: Work from (almost!) anywhere. 🌍🧑‍💻 Some roles need you in a specific country or time zone — we'll always flag that in the job ad. And whenever you like, come co-work with us in Mannheim, Berlin, or Sydney. 🏢

  • One Team, One Vision, One Goal: We’re in this together! 🤝 Our Genies are laser-focused on our mission, collaborating to make magic happen. ✨ It’s no wonder we score a stellar 9.3 from our team members! 🌟

  • Epic Team Gatherings: Every year, we bring our global crew together 🌎 for a week of networking, brainstorming, and fun. 🎉 Plus, enjoy regular hangouts in our offices to keep the camaraderie alive.

  • Growth and Development: We’re all about lifelong learning! 📚 Level up your skills with personal and professional development opportunities. You’ll even snag up to three extra days off each year to focus on your growth. 📈

  • 5 Years? 5 Weeks! Stick with us, and we’ll reward your loyalty. After five years, you’ll earn an incredible five weeks of bonus vacation time 🏖️ to recharge and explore the world. 🌍

  • Birthday Celebrations: It’s your day, so take it off! 🎂 Celebrate your birthday the way you want, guilt-free.

  • Flexible Hours: We get it—life happens! ⏰ We offer flexible working hours to help you balance your work and personal life seamlessly.

  • Wellbeing Matters: Your mental health is a top priority. 🧘 Every Genie gets access to Headspace, the leading meditation app, to help you cultivate a happier, healthier, and more zen life. 🌿

  • BetterHelp Support: We also offer BetterHelp, a professional online therapy and counseling platform, giving you additional support whenever you need it.💛🧠

We kindly ask that recruitment agencies refrain from reaching out regarding this vacancy. Thank you for your understanding.

Compensation: £34K – £36K • Offers Commission

description_html:
Up to £80,000 DOE plus Welcome Bonus up to £5,000 and Relocation Allowance up to £5,000
 
 
At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.
 
 
Peacehaven is our purpose-built small animal, first opinion branch based in the vibrant seaside town of Brighton & Hove that delivers advanced general practice services to clients on the coast, but clients also benefit from the skill sets and facilities available at the Brighton hospital if required. With its exciting and diverse culture, beautiful beach and seafront and excellent transport links to central London and Gatwick airport, Brighton and the surrounding area is a fantastic place to live. 
 
 
We are looking for an enthusiastic candidate with some years of experience who enjoys working sole charge, running a branch under the guidance and leadership of the Director of Clinical Services. Our objective is always to maintain a happy and supportive work environment and ensure our patients receive excellent clinical care. 
 
 

How You’ll Make a Difference

 
 
As a Senior Veterinary Surgeon, you’ll work collaboratively with the wider team to deliver a high standard of patient and client care across a varied and rewarding caseload.
 
You’ll continue to develop your clinical skills and interests while sharing your knowledge and experience with colleagues, contributing positively to the clinical culture of the practice. You’ll be an integral member of the clinical team, delivering excellent care and supporting the ongoing development of those around you.
 

Working Pattern

 
* 40 hours per week 
* Shifts are issued 12 weeks in advance and typically run between 8:00am and 7:00pm
* No out-of-hours commitment
 
 

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

 
 
You are a confident and motivated Veterinary Surgeon who enjoys working as part of a team and is committed to delivering high-quality patient and client care. You’ll bring:
 
 
* A Veterinary degree and registration (or eligibility to register) with the RCVS
* Experience working in clinical practice with growing confidence in routine medical and surgical cases
* Strong communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships with clients and colleagues
* A proactive approach to learning, with openness to feedback and development
* Professionalism, reliability and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
 
 

How We’ll Support You

 
 
At inspiring vet care, we’re committed to supporting your ongoing development and wellbeing. When you join us, you’ll benefit from:
 
* Clear career pathways with progression opportunities across primary care, referral, leadership and specialist roles
* Funded learning and development, including CPD allowance and access to IVC Academy training centres and role-relevant courses
* £1,250 annual Care Fund for every vet
* Access to mentors, regional clinical coaches and peer networks
* Support to develop clinical interests and expand your capabilities
* A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, community and continuous improvement
 
 

What We Offer Our Team

 
 
* 6.8 weeks’ holiday, including bank holidays
* Private medical insurance
* Enhanced family leave and pay across maternity, paternity, adoption and surrogacy
* BVA membership, VDS cover & RCVS fees
* Cycle to Work and Green Car schemes (eligibility applies)

title: Software/Data Engineer

description_html:
Are you looking for a new challenge?

Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?

Prima could be the place for you. 

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.


To help fuel that growth, we need a Data Engineer to join our Engineering team. 
 
This team is the beating heart of Prima. 
 
You’ll be joining over 300 engineers across software development, infrastructure, operations and security. Fueled by curiosity, experimentation and collaboration, you’ll help deliver scalable, impactful solutions that shape the future of insurance.
 
Excited to make an impact? Here are the details
 
You’ll be joining our pricing and underwriting domain to bridge the gap between machine learning/data science and engineering. You will help build, publish, and maintain our complex data products and pipelines, key elements that have a significant impact on the company’s growth.

What you’ll do
  • Shaping the architecture of data products designed for data analytics and data science specifically focusing on use cases like forecasting, feature engineering, customer behaviour, and integration of new data sources.
  • Leading the way in data transformation by setting up best practices in areas like Data modelling, performance optimisation, Data Governance etc, ensuring that the data used within Prima is consistent, available and reliable.
  • Build reusable technology that enables teams to ingest, store, transform, and serve their own data products.
  • Engaging with data scientists and machine learning engineers to explore the product landscape and refine data requirements for enhanced data infrastructure.
  • Embrace continuous learning and experimentation to stay updated on emerging technologies, from testing open source tools to engaging in community-building activities like Meetups. Your passion for staying at the forefront of the field will drive your journey.
    •  

    What we’re looking for
  • Expert in batch, distributed data processing and near real-time streaming data pipelines with technologies like Kafka, Flink, Spark etc. Experience in Databricks is a plus.
  • Experience in Data Lake / Big Data Analytics platform implementation with cloud based solution; AWS preferred.
  • Proficient in Python programming and software engineering best practices.
  • Expertise with RDBMS, Data Warehousing, Data Modelling with relational SQL (Redshift, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases.
  • Proficiency in DevOps, CI/CD pipeline management, and expertise in infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployment industry-best practices.
    •  

    Nice-to-Have
  • Hands-on experience in Data Quality and Data Governance techniques.
  • Knowledge on MLOps and Feature engineering.
  • Exposure to common data analysis and ML technologies such as on scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, XGBoost, LightGBM.
  • Exposure to tools like Apache Oozie, Apache Airflow.
    •  
    Why you’ll love it here:
     
    We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks.
     
    🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year.

    🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

    🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

    Think you’re a match? Apply now.

     

    At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

    Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at ----- Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

About Numan 
 
Founded in 2018, we’ve already grown to be a 300+ team distributed across the globe, united by a singular mission: empowering people to take control of their health.
 
Numan is transforming health: we’ve built a cutting-edge platform that integrates diagnostics, medication, supplements, digital programmes, and doctor consultations. Giving people the tools they need to maximise life.
 
To deliver on our transformative mission, we are guided by our 5 company values: 
 
• Patients first.
• Learn fast.
• Own the quality.
• Succeed together.
• Care deeply.
 
Backed by top-tier investors, Numan is already having a positive impact on hundreds of thousands of patients here in the UK, and we want you to help us deliver this mission!

The role

As Numan enters an exciting new chapter of AI-powered analytics, we're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to sit at the core of our data platform and drive better decisions across the entire business.

This is one of the most varied analytics engineering roles in digital health. Your work will span multiple domains - from commercial performance and marketing effectiveness through to health outcomes analytics and clinical operations - giving you a genuinely broad view of the business and the full patient journey.

We are embarking on a strategic investment in AI-powered analytics, with a full remit to explore and adopt the latest and greatest technologies. You'll be shaping which tools, approaches, and practices Numan adopts as a company.

Reporting to the Head of Data Engineering and collaborating closely with data scientists, analysts, and stakeholders across the business.


You'll be:

  • Designing, building, and maintaining scalable, well-tested dbt data models that power analytics across commercial, marketing, health outcomes, and clinical operations domains.

title: Werkstudent in der Netzwirtschaft / Energiewirtschaft (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at CURRENTA GRUPPE
description_html:
Die CURRENTA GRUPPE sucht Dich für die Business Unit Energy.

Als Werkstudent*in in der Netzwirtschaft / Energiewirtschaft bist du für die folgenden Aufgaben verantwortlich:

  • Du hilfst bei der Bearbeitung von energiewirtschaftlichen & regulatorischen Grundsatzfragen.

  • Im Rahmen der Anwendung gesetzlicher Neuerungen sammelst du praxisnahe Einblicke in die Energiewirtschaft und kannst so neben der Vertiefung deiner Fachkenntnisse deine Ideen in die weitere Umsetzung mit einbringen.

  • Du hilfst uns bei der Datenerfassung und Datenanalyse rund um den Netzbetrieb.

  • Du hast die Möglichkeit an übergreifenden Projekten wie beispielsweise Redispatch 2.0 oder dem Ausbau erneuerbarer Energien mitzuwirken.


  • Du absolvierst Dein Studium im Bereich der Ingenieurs-, Natur- oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang mit einem Schwerpunkt der Energiewirtschaft.

  • Du hattest idealerweise bereits erste Berührungspunkte mit einem Unternehmen aus der Industrie (Studium, Beruf oder privat).

  • Deine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise zeichnet dich aus.

  • Du zeigst Teamfähigkeit und Kommunikationsstärke.

  • Du bist motiviert die Welt der regulierten Netzwirtschaft näher kennenzulernen und mit den Besonderheiten eines Chempark-Betreibers zu verknüpfen.

Hinweis:

Die Gehaltsangabe basiert auf einer Wochenarbeitszeit von 20 Stunden in Teilzeit und je nach Studiengrad (Bachelor / Master). In den vorlesungsfreien Zeiten ist eine Stundenaufstockung möglich.

Die Veröffentlichung dieser Anzeige auf Drittanbieter-Portalen ohne unsere ausdrückliche Zustimmung ist untersagt.

title: Senior MVNO Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at 1Global
description_html:
About Us

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider helping enterprises and consumer brands deliver seamless connectivity worldwide. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries.


Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe's fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses.


Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. With annual revenues exceeding US$200 million and a strong track record of profitability, we continue to invest in innovation, infrastructure, and international expansion as we redefine the future of global mobile connectivity.

About the Team

1GLOBAL’s Wholesale team is a fundamental enabler for the 1GLOBAL business and this is a critical and high profile role at the heart of Wholesale’s activities.  The Wholesale team is responsible for the establishment and management of relationships with mobile operators who provide 1GLOBAL with connectivity into our global core network from which we serve not just our own IoT and business customers but also important channel partners who we are enabling to set up their own MVNOs.  We’re working with brands like Revolut and LIDL to enable them to offer domestic service across Europe.  And there’s more coming!  The Senior MVNO Manager will act as the account manager for all our MVNO relationships to ensure we have the most effective commercial structure in place to meet the future requirements of the business.  This role will be vital not just for the expansion of 1GLOBAL’s own MVNO footprint but also to ensure that the we have the right MNO partnerships to enable the likes of Revolut to keep growing their global footprint too.  

We’re a global team and are open to hiring candidates based in Berlin, London, Lisbon, or Amsterdam.

About the Role

  • Working across the business to ensure the existing MVNO businesses are maximized and opportunities for growth are realized, reducing the Minimum Revenue Guarantee (MRG) shortfalls in key countries.
  • Looking at how we get MVNO-type access into additional countries outside the existing MVNO base, both for the 1GLOBAL footprint and for the new rollouts we’ll be doing with Revolut and other partners.  Working cross-functionally in order to drive and oversee implementation.
  • Advising the business of the correct country structure for each of our MVNO countries e.g. identifying whether an MVNO remains appropriate to achieving our business goals.
  • Owning operational performance against contract, including service level measures, escalations, and change requests.
  • Negotiating all MVNO agreements/addendums – including ensuring the timely implementation of all new technologies including VoLTE, 5G & LPWAN as part of the MVNO agreements

Requirements

About You

Must Have

  • Good experience in mobile wholesale (ideally MVNO/MVNE and/or roaming)
  • Strong understanding of the mobile sector and technology
  • Excellent commercial skills and a strong analytical ability
  • Excellent communicator; highly organised; forthright; able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Driven, energetic, and resilient, able to thrive under pressure in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Ability to think creatively and strategically and translate strategic thinking into solid deliverables and plans
  • Able to form strong relationships both with our partners and internal stakeholders


Nice to Have

  • A solid base of industry contacts
  • Track record launching an MVNO from scratch or scaling one across new markets
  • Knowledge of telecom regulatory environments (Ofcom, FCC, national regulators) across relevant markets
  • Experience in fintech or telecom-adjacent sectors

Benefits

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 50% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.
