Was uns auszeichnet? Wir denken ganzheitlich. Von der strategischen Beratung bis zur Implementierung begleiten wir unsere Kunden End-to-End – mit Kreativität, technologischer Exzellenz und einem tiefen Verständnis für ihre Geschäftsmodelle. So entstehen messbarer Fortschritt und nachhaltiger Impact.
 
Und jetzt kommst du: Wir suchen Menschen mit Neugier, Ambition und dem Mut, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Menschen, die Lust haben, Neues zu lernen, unsere Kunden zu begeistern und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen.


Deine Aufgaben:

Deine Mission: Suche verändert sich gerade schneller als jedes Lehrbuch mitschreiben kann. Unsere Kunden – B2B-Marktführer aus Maschinenbau, Industrie und Handel – werden nicht mehr nur bei Google gefunden, sondern auch in ChatGPT, Perplexity und Google AI Mode. Wie man das systematisch messbar macht, ist eine offene Frage. Wir bauen dafür gerade eine Methodik auf, und du bist dabei nicht die Person, die Folien formatiert, sondern die, die die Daten liefert, auf denen die Methodik steht.

  • AI-Sichtbarkeit messen: Du führst unsere definierten Prompt-Sets regelmäßig über ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot und Google AI Mode aus, dokumentierst, welche Marken und Quellen zitiert werden, und erkennst Veränderungen über die Zeit. Das ist die Datengrundlage, aus der unsere GEO-Methodik entsteht.
  • SEO-Daten aufbereiten: Crawls mit Screaming Frog, Exporte aus der Search Console, Ranking- und Wettbewerbsvergleiche. Du bringst Rohdaten in eine Form, mit der man arbeiten kann – und fällst auf, wenn dir dabei etwas Merkwürdiges auffällt.
  • Logfiles auswerten: Du prüfst, ob und wie AI-Crawler wie GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot oder PerplexityBot auf Kundenseiten zugreifen – und ob sie vielleicht geblockt werden, ohne dass es jemand gemerkt hat.
  • Tracking testen: Du prüfst nach, ob Tracking-Setups wirklich das tun, was sie sollen: Events feuern, Consent-Zustände greifen, Zahlen plausibel. Du lernst dabei GA4 und Google Tag Manager von der Seite kennen, die man in keinem Kurs sieht.
  • Reportings vorbereiten: Du baust die Datenbasis für monatliche Kunden-Reportings auf und lernst, welche Zahl eine Entscheidung stützt und welche nur den Report füllt.
  • Methodik dokumentieren: Du hältst fest, wie wir vorgehen – Prompt-Sets, Definitionen, Grenzen der Messung. Am Ende deines Praktikums existiert etwas, das ohne dich weiterläuft. Das ist der Teil, auf den du später im Bewerbungsgespräch zeigen kannst.
  • Mitdenken erlaubt, ausdrücklich: Du sitzt in Team-Terminen dabei, hörst mit, wenn Ergebnisse diskutiert werden, und darfst fragen, warum wir etwas so machen. Manchmal ist die ehrliche Antwort „weil wir es immer so gemacht haben“ – und dann ist deine Frage die beste des Tages.


Damit kannst Du punkten:

  • Studium oder Quereinstieg: Du studierst etwas mit Daten, Marketing, Wirtschaft, Medien oder Informatik im Master oder du kommst über einen anderen Weg und kannst erklären, warum dich das Thema packt. Wir sind an Köpfen interessiert, nicht an Studienordnungen.
  • Erste Praxiserfahrung: Mindestens eine relevante Station, in der du schon in einem Team mit echten Deadlines mitgearbeitet hast. Ein vorheriges Praktikum oder eine Werkstudentenstelle in einer Agentur, einer Beratung, einem B2B-Unternehmen oder einem internationalen Konzern, gerne auch Freelance-Arbeit oder ein eigenes Projekt mit Kunden. Das ist für uns keine Formalie: Wer den Projektalltag schon einmal von innen gesehen hat, steigt hier deutlich schneller ein.
  • Sorgfalt: Ein Großteil dieser Arbeit ist wiederholbare Messung. Wer dabei ungenau wird, produziert Daten, auf die man nichts stellen kann. Wenn du weißt, dass Genauigkeit deine Stärke ist, ist das hier mehr wert als jede Tool-Zertifizierung.
  • Neugier auf AI, nicht nur Nutzung: Du hast ChatGPT und Perplexity nicht nur benutzt, sondern dich schon gefragt, woher die Antworten eigentlich kommen. Eine eigene Beobachtung dazu ist uns lieber als eine Aufzählung von Tools.
  • Excel oder Sheets solide, und keine Angst vor größeren Datenmengen. Erste Berührung mit SQL, GA4 oder Search Console ist ein Plus.
  • Selbstständigkeit im Rahmen: Du fragst nach, wenn etwas unklar ist, statt zu raten und arbeitest dann eigenständig weiter, hands-on, ohne dass jemand nachschauen muss.
  • Sprachen: Sehr gutes Deutsch, sicheres Englisch.
  • Verfügbarkeit: Mindestens 6 Monate. Kürzer lohnt sich für dich nicht – die ersten Wochen gehen fürs Reinkommen drauf.


Was wir von Dir benötigen:

Mission started?! Dann brauchen wir von Dir:   

  • Deinen CV
  • Welche Vergütung Du Dir für Deine Performance vorstellst
  • Deine Kündigungsfrist bzw. möglicher Starttermin

Ein Praktikum ist bei uns kein Parkplatz. Du arbeitest an einem Thema, das noch niemand fertig gelöst hat – mit echten Kundendaten, in einem Team, das dich fragt, was du gesehen hast.

title: Account Executive (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Bliq
description_html:
Your mission

At Bliq, we are building and launching driverless vehicles for everyday life and business operations across Europe.

We are looking for a Account Executive to help bring them to customers.

You will acquire business and individual customers across European markets and own the commercial process end-to-end: identify and engage prospects, run discovery, demonstrate the product in person, design the right commercial and operating model for each customer, build proposals, negotiate, and close.

Our customers can look very different. One week, you may be discussing a fleet deployment with a taxi or car-sharing company. The next, you may be showing the vehicle to a real-estate company, law firm, mobility operator, or prospective individual customer.

This is not a role where you inherit a mature market, established category, and optimized sales playbook. Driverless technology is only getting started in Europe. You will need to understand unfamiliar customer problems quickly, figure out how Bliq can solve them, and help us discover how this technology should be sold.

You will work closely with the Commercial Lead and founders to refine Bliq’s sales playbook market by market.

Responsibilities

  • Own the sales cycle from first conversation through signed contract

  • Build pipeline through targeted outbound and proactive prospecting across European markets

  • Run sharp discovery conversations that uncover customer operations, economics, pain points, and decision criteria

  • Conduct live Bliq vehicle demos and turn the experience into a compelling commercial conversation

  • Develop deployment concepts together with prospects, including use case, fleet size, operating model, responsibilities, economics, and rollout plan

  • Create proposals, commercial models, LOIs, and contracts together with the relevant internal teams

  • Navigate complex buying processes involving operators, management teams, fleet owners, partners, and other stakeholders

  • Build relationships with customers across mobility, taxi, car sharing, rental, real estate, professional services, and other relevant sectors

  • Own defined markets and be accountable for commercial progress within them

  • Keep CRM data, pipeline, next steps, and forecasts accurate

  • Test new segments, messages, channels, and commercial models and turn what works into repeatable processes

  • Work closely with the Customer Deployment team to make sure signed customers can actually be deployed successfully

  • Represent Bliq at customer meetings, industry events, demos, and market visits across Europe

  • Support B2C sales initiatives when they become part of the GTM strategy

  • Bring customer feedback directly into Bliq’s product, operations, and commercial decisions



Your profile

Apply if this describes you:

  • You have at least 2 years of Account Executive or comparable full-cycle sales experience

  • You are a hunter and enjoy creating opportunities rather than waiting for inbound demand

  • You learn quickly and can become credible on a complex technical product without hiding behind technical jargon

  • You are excellent face-to-face and comfortable walking into an important customer meeting, running the room, and demonstrating a physical product

  • You are customer-first and care about finding solutions that make customers satisfied

  • You have strong commercial judgment and understand how to turn customer needs into a viable deal

  • You write clearly and can produce concise, convincing emails, proposals, and commercial documents

  • You are highly organized and detail-oriented; pipeline hygiene, follow-ups, and commitments do not get lost

  • You have CRM experience and understand disciplined sales processes

  • Experience with tools such as Clay, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar is a plus

  • You know how to use AI to research, prepare, analyze, and move faster while keeping the thinking and customer judgment your own

  • You have a figure-it-out mindset and remain effective when there is no existing template for the problem

  • You are comfortable owning a market or commercial project and being measured by the outcome

  • You can work professionally in German and English; additional European languages are a plus

  • You are based in Berlin

  • You are willing to travel regularly across Europe

  • Experience selling hardware, mobility, automotive, physical technology, or other operationally complex products is a strong plus

This role will probably not suit you if you want an established sales process, a narrowly defined territory, a predictable product demo, or a manager telling you exactly what to do next.

It will suit you if you want to help create a category, sell something people can experience in the real world, and build the commercial machine while running it.


Why us?

  • Sell a product people are excited about

  • Build Bliq’s sales playbook together with the Commercial Lead

  • Work directly with the founders and senior team

  • Own meaningful customer relationships and markets from an early stage

  • Work on complex deals combining technology, vehicles, operations, economics, and regulation

  • See deals move from your first message to vehicles operating on public roads with the customer

  • Fast decisions, direct feedback, and no bureaucracy

  • Strong compensation package with meaningful upside for performance

  • Significant room to grow as Bliq expands across European markets

Tips for a successful application

  1. Show us that you can sell. Generic applications tell us very little.

  2. Tell us what you have personally owned and what results you produced.

  3. If you have built pipeline, opened a new market, sold a difficult product, or closed an unusual deal, tell us how.

  4. Use AI as a tool. Make sure the thinking and personality in your application are yours.

title: System Software Engineer (gn) Cloud & Simulation
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Wandelbots GmbH
description_html:
Your mission

At Wandelbots, we are building NOVA, a platform that makes industrial robot programming accessible to everyone. Our Simulation team develops the technologies that allow partners, customers, and internal teams to work with photorealistic digital twins of real production environments.

This includes a pipeline that transforms real-world scans into usable 3D scenes through Gaussian Splatting, as well as a browser-based streaming platform built on NVIDIA Omniverse and Isaac Sim. Both technologies work today, but neither is yet operated as a product. Your mission is to change that.

The first step is internal standardization. We want to replace individually maintained environments and hand-crafted deployments with one reproducible, documented solution that teams can use independently: scene in, session out, without requiring the Simulation team to operate every setup.
The second step is external productization. The same capabilities need to be packaged so that partners and customers can operate them in their own environments. 
E.g. with versioned releases, stable interfaces, tenant isolation, diagnostics, upgrade paths, and documentation.

You will join the Simulation team and focus on the infrastructure and operational foundations of these systems. You will not be building them in isolation: Wandelbots has an established infrastructure team responsible for shared infrastructure and platform capabilities. You will work closely with that team while owning the simulation-specific workloads, deployment patterns, and operational requirements.

This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape architecture and make technical decisions in collaboration with the teams involved.

What you will work on

  • Build and operate the GPU infrastructure required by our simulation workloads, including NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, driver lifecycle, and GPU sharing through MIG or time slicing

  • Work with the infrastructure team to integrate simulation workloads into our shared Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure

  • Make deployments declarative and reproducible using Infrastructure as Code and GitOps, and help consolidate the tooling used across today’s environments

  • Own CI/CD and the container and image lifecycle for CUDA- and NGC-based workloads

  • Design scheduling and autoscaling for two distinct workload profiles: latency-sensitive interactive streaming sessions and compute-intensive Gaussian Splatting jobs

  • Turn the Gaussian Splatting pipeline into a reproducible workflow, from data capture and training to OpenUSD assets

  • Operate and extend our Omniverse and Isaac Sim streaming platform, including Kit App Streaming, session lifecycle, and tenant isolation

  • Establish the platform as an internal standard through self-service workflows, golden paths, templates, onboarding, and documentation

  • Prepare the solution for operation by partners and customers through packaged deployments, versioned releases, upgrade paths, and actionable diagnostics

  • Support deployments across cloud, on-premises, and partner-managed environments

  • Build meaningful observability using metrics, logs, GPU telemetry, and actionable alerting

  • Define the simulation-specific security and access model, including ingress, TURN and STUN for WebRTC, RBAC, secrets management, SSO, and tenant boundaries

  • Work closely with our robotics, product, and platform teams to ensure that the solution supports real development and customer workflows



Your profile

We are looking for an engineer who is interested in how complex systems are built, deployed, and operated, not only in delivering the next application feature.
You should bring:

  • Experience building or operating production systems in platform engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or systems software

  • Practical Kubernetes experience, including resource management, workload scheduling, and debugging distributed systems under load

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and CI/CD, together with the ability to evaluate tools based on the problem rather than a fixed preference

  • Solid knowledge of Linux, containers, and networking

  • Good Python skills for automation, services, and data-processing workflows

  • Experience with GPU workloads, or a strong technical foundation and clear interest in working with drivers, CUDA, and GPU scheduling

  • The ability to turn working technology into a system that other teams can use independently

  • A strong sense of operational ownership, including documentation, diagnostics, maintainability, and reproducibility

  • Very good English; German is a plus


We do not expect candidates to have prior experience with every technology in this description. A strong systems foundation, the ability to learn unfamiliar components, and an interest in this problem space are more important than matching every item. The scope and responsibilities of the role will grow with your experience.


Nice to have

  • Experience turning an internally developed system into a product that can be operated in customer-controlled environments

  • Hands-on experience with NVIDIA Omniverse, Isaac Sim, Kit SDK, or OpenUSD

  • Experience with Gaussian Splatting, NeRF, photogrammetry, or comparable 3D reconstruction pipelines

  • Knowledge of WebRTC, pixel streaming, or other low-latency video technologies

  • Python, Rust, or Go skills sufficient to contribute to existing services and infrastructure tooling

  • Experience with robotics or simulation, such as ROS 2 or sim-to-real workflows

  • Experience with multi-tenant platforms, air-gapped deployments, or customer environments with specific security and compliance requirements



Why us?

Make an impact!
Work on an innovative, deep tech product that adds value to the robotics world and to society! Become a crucial part of something new, big and exciting where you can truly make an impact!

Our teams inspire!
Cross-functional communication is key. You'll get to know many of your 100+ colleagues. Collaborate with great people on our international teams who value knowledge sharing and unique ways of doing things!

Be authentic!
Work in a value-driven environment where everything may not be perfect, but we're working on it! Your feedback is required while you receive feedback and appreciation for your work!

Help others!
You can have up to 3 days of volunteer time off to help your favorite charity.

Develop yourself!
We offer training and mental health opportunities so that you can develop both mentally and professionally.

And there is even more!
Enjoy our free lunch, snacks and drinks, team events, 30 days of annual vacation + additional rest during Christmas season until New Year. If your child gets sick, we assure that a 100% of your usual earnings will be paid while you take care of your little one.

Your mission

IONITY baut ein europaweites Netzwerk von High-Power-Ladestationen auf und betreibt dieses. Als Senior Rollout Manager übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung mehrerer Ladestandorte in der DACH-Region – von der Rollout-Planung und der Standortvorbereitung über die Bauphase, Inbetriebnahme und Abnahme bis zur Übergabe an Operations. Du überführst komplexe, funktionsübergreifende Projekte in einen planbaren und verlässlichen Rollout neuer Standorte.
Die Rolle verbindet Projektmanagement, Infrastrukturentwicklung und Stakeholder-Management. Du koordinierst interne Teams, Behörden, Grundstückseigentümer, Netzbetreiber, Baufirmen, Installationspartner und spezialisierte Partner auf gemeinsame Meilensteine, Entscheidungen und Qualitätsstandards. Deine Arbeit leistet einen direkten Beitrag zum Wachstum des europäischen IONITY Netzwerks, sowie einem zuverlässigen Ladeerlebnis für Elektrofahrzeugfahrerinnen und -fahrer aus ganz Europa. Jede neue Ladesäule als Ergebnis deiner Arbeit beschleunigt die Verkehrswende und ist ein wichtiger Beitrag für eine emissionsfreie Mobilität.

  • Du übernimmst die ganzheitliche Verantwortung für die Umsetzung eines Portfolios von HPC-Ladestandorten in der DACH-Region, mit besonderem Fokus auf die komplexesten, risikoreichsten oder strategisch wichtigsten Standorte. Über den gesamten Projektlebenszyklus hinweg steuerst du Umfang, Zeitplan, Abhängigkeiten, Risikoexponierung, Kostenrisiken, Qualität, Sicherheit, Compliance und die betriebliche Umsetzungsreife.
  • Du übersetzt die Rollout-Ziele in integrierte Standort- und Portfolioumsetzungspläne, definierst Prioritäten, Reihenfolgen, Meilensteine und Abhängigkeiten und stellst eine klare Governance sicher – von der Standortentwicklung und Genehmigungsplanung über die Bauphase und Inbetriebnahme bis zur Übergabe an den Betrieb.
  • Du führst die funktionsübergreifende Umsetzung über die Bereiche Planung und Genehmigung, Bau, Netzanschluss, Logistik etc. hinweg, treibst zeitnahe Entscheidungen voran, löst Konflikte und stellst sicher, dass kritische Schnittstellen zwischen Grundstück, Tiefbau, Elektrotechnik, Netzanschluss, Installation der Ladehardware, Prüfung und Inbetriebnahme aktiv gesteuert werden.
  • Du steuerst externe Planungsbüros, Auftragnehmer, Installationsunternehmen und weitere Umsetzungspartner direkt, setzt klare Erwartungen, überwachst die Leistung, steuerst die operative Umsetzung sowie kommerzielle Risiken und stellst sicher, dass die Partner die vereinbarten Ergebnisse liefern.
  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für das Risiko-, Änderungs- und Maßnahmenmanagement des Portfolios, identifizierst kritische Risiken frühzeitig, definierst Gegenmaßnahmen und führst Wiederherstellungspläne für verspätete, blockierte oder erheblich vom Plan abweichende Standorte. Dabei schützt du Umsetzungsqualität, Sicherheit und Compliance.
  • Du triffst Entscheidungen innerhalb deines übertragenen Verantwortungs- und Entscheidungsrahmens und erstellst klare Entscheidungsvorlagen für den Country Manager DACH, sofern eine Eskalation erforderlich ist. Du stellst tragfähige Optionen, Auswirkungen und Empfehlungen dar und wägst dabei Zeitplan, Kosten, Qualität, technische Machbarkeit und die Anforderungen der Stakeholder gegeneinander ab.
  • Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu Behörden, Netzbetreibern, Grundstückseigentümern, lokalen Stakeholdern und Umsetzungspartnern auf und pflegst diese, vertrittst IONITY auch in komplexen Gesprächen professionell und löst Genehmigungs-, Netzanschluss-, Grundstücks-, Bau- und sonstige Umsetzungshindernisse pragmatisch.
  • Du erstellst prägnante und entscheidungsorientierte Berichte für Senior Stakeholder, einschließlich Fortschritt, prognostizierter Termine, Prognosesicherheit, wesentlicher Risiken, Kosten- und kommerzieller Risiken, Partnerleistung, Maßnahmen zur Planwiederherstellung sowie der erforderlichen Entscheidungen, um das Portfolio auf Kurs zu halten.
  • Du etablierst und verbesserst kontinuierlich Rollout-Standards, Governance-Routinen, Vorlagen und Umsetzungsleitfäden. Auf Basis gewonnener Erkenntnisse erhöhst du die Planbarkeit, Qualität, Skalierbarkeit und Umsetzungseffektivität des Rollouts im gesamten DACH-Netzwerk.


Your profile

  • Du bist ein Teamplayer und arbeitest auch unter Zeitdruck mit einem hohen Anspruch an Qualität.
  • Du verfügst über nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Leitung der Umsetzung komplexer Infrastruktur-, Bau-, Energie-, Mobilitäts-, Telekommunikations- oder vergleichbarer Rollout-Programme über mehrere Standorte hinweg, ideralerweise im Bereich HPC Ladeinfrastruktur.
  • Du kannst eine Erfolgsbilanz bei der Übernahme von Ergebnisverantwortung über den gesamten Umsetzungslebenszyklus vorweisen – und nicht nur für einzelne Projektaufgaben oder Arbeitspakete.
  • Du verfügst über ausgeprägte Kenntnisse in Programm- und Projektsteuerung, einschließlich integrierter Planung, Risikomanagement, Abhängigkeitsmanagement, Änderungssteuerung und Reporting auf Senior-Ebene.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Steuerung externer Partner sowie in der Einflussnahme auf interne Stakeholder in einer Matrixorganisation. Du trittst sicher auf, stellst bestehende Ansätze konstruktiv infrage, triffst Entscheidungen und eskalierst Themen, wenn dies erforderlich ist.
  • Du verfügst über ein fundiertes praktisches Verständnis der Schnittstellen zwischen Standortentwicklung, Genehmigungsplanung, Tiefbau, Elektrotechnik, Netzanschluss, Inbetriebnahme und Übergabe an den Betrieb.
  • Du kommunizierst klar und strukturiert auf Deutsch und Englisch.
  • Du besitzt einen gültigen Führerschein und bist bereit, regelmäßig mit Teams an den Standorten zusammenzuarbeiten.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Ladeinfrastruktur für Elektrofahrzeuge, Anlagen im Bereich erneuerbare Energien oder anderer dezentraler, kundenorientierter Infrastruktur.
  • Du verfügst über etablierte Arbeitsbeziehungen zu Behörden, Netzbetreibern, Grundstückseigentümern und Baupartnern in einem oder mehreren DACH-Märkten.
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Schnittstellen zu Hochspannungs- oder elektrotechnischer Infrastruktur sowie mit der Inbetriebnahme und Übergabe in ein operatives Netzwerk.
  • Du verfügst über gute Anwenderkenntnisse in AutoCAD und Microsoft Office, einschließlich fortgeschrittener Excel-Kenntnisse oder vergleichbarer Projektsteuerungs-Tools.
  • Du hast ein einschlägiges Hochschulstudium, eine technische Qualifikation oder vergleichbare berufliche Erfahrung in den Bereichen Ingenieurwesen, Bauwesen, Infrastruktur oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet.

description_html:
About us

Netlight is an international digital consulting firm, helping leading companies to succeed in the digital landscape, from advice to implementation. Our service contains the collective intelligence of more than 2000 consultants offering a comprehensive range of digital services, from strategy to technology. Co-creating the future today, since 1999.
 
Netlight has been awarded several times for profitable growth and management, as a top employer, and for our engagement in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion. Located in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Oslo, Helsinki, Copenhagen, Munich, Hamburg, Berlin, Frankfurt, Zurich, Cologne, Amsterdam, Madrid, Toronto and London.
 

What does it mean to be a consultant at Netlight? 

Join the Netlight Hamburg team as a consultant and be a part of shaping the software products and technical solutions of today and tomorrow alongside your colleagues and clients. Our focus is not just on the digital product, but also on the team and the business. You'll have the ownership to carve your own career path, choosing from a range of clients and roles based on your personal experience, strengths, interests, and market demand. Our projects encompass a wide technical spectrum, including Fullstack Development, Backend, Data Engineering, Cloud Solutions, Architecture, Web Development, DevOps, and more. Instead of predefined roles, we tailor positions to fit individuals. At Netlight, you define your career path, clients you engage with, your role (based on your strengths, interests, and experience), and your connections with mentors, coaches, EDGE networks, and social circles. The possibilities are endless. Come build the future with us at Netlight.

Who you are
  • Soon-to-be/recent Graduate (2026/2027) with a relevant Master’s Degree in Computer Science, IT, Business Informatics or similar (or Bachelor's + ≥2yrs of full-time experience)
  • Full business-level fluency in English
  • Some hands-on industry experience through internships, working student roles or full-time in Software Engineering, Data Engineering or IT-Management with modern technologies, (e.g. Fullstack Development, Backend, Data Engineering, Cloud Solutions, Architecture, Web Development, DevOps, Product Ownership or similar)
  • Based in Hamburg or willing to relocate to Hamburg (for other locations, please apply to our other openings)

    • We offer
  • Possibility to be part of growing one of the most successful tech consultancies in the industry
  • Diverse client landscape, incl. some of the most innovative tech companies & exciting projects with lots of room for professional development
  • Access to an international network of 2,000+ highly talented individuals
  • An experienced mentor and a professional coach to guide you throughout your career
  • An international & diverse working environment with a central and modern office space
  • Competitive and transparent salary model with equal pay regardless of the assignment, biannual salary reviews, and attractive benefits (e.g. company shares, Deutschlandticket, parental benefits & much more)

    • Come work with us

    Netlight as a company strives to be a truly diverse, equitable, and inclusive organisation. Regardless of who you are, what personality, background, and experience you have, you enrich our culture through your values. Netlight’s purpose is to unleash full potential, realise great careers, and fulfil personal growth.
     
    To achieve this, we have a highly engaged network organisation, where every employee gets a mentor, delivery coach, and personal communities. The key to our continued success is trust and personal responsibility, diverse experiences, challenging opportunities, and development based on personal values. Every Netlighter is an active part of building and shaping this culture, which leads to a clear correlation between personal growth and the growth of Netlight.
     
    Ready to shape the future with us?

title: Job Title Senior Account Executive - Maritime - Germany
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Kpler
description_html:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

About the Role

As a Senior Account Executive focusing on the Maritime sector across Germany and Switzerland, you will be instrumental in expanding Kpler’s footprint in one of Europe’s most dynamic market regions. Working within our Mid-Market EMEA team, you will drive new account acquisition and uncover high-impact expansion opportunities by connecting commercial leaders with actionable data intelligence. In this role, your expertise will directly influence how maritime organizations make critical global trade decisions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Drive new account acquisition across Germany and Switzerland to consistently meet and exceed annual revenue targets.

  • Uncover and execute strategic upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts to maximize customer lifetime value.

  • Partner with cross-functional commercial teams to support territory forecasting, demand planning, and multi-year strategic goals.

  • Gather direct customer and market feedback to provide actionable product and competitive insights back to internal strategy teams.

  • Maintain rigorous CRM data hygiene in Salesforce to ensure transparent pipeline reporting and accurate revenue forecasting.

  • Represent Kpler externally with authority and professionalism, positioning our data solutions as essential for maritime industry leaders.


    • Experience & Background

    What you'll need (Must-haves):

    • 5+ years of commercial sales experience with a track record of driving new logo acquisition in a Senior AE role.

    • Proven background selling B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, or data intelligence solutions to corporate stakeholders.

    • Native or professional fluency in both German and English.

    • Strong negotiation skills combined with a proactive "hunter" mindset to independently develop and close high-value pipeline.

      • Nice-to-haves:

      • Direct commercial experience or domain knowledge within the maritime or global commodities trading sectors.

      • Hands-on proficiency with modern revenue enablement platforms (e.g., Salesforce, ZoomInfo, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).

      • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).

    We are a dynamic company dedicated to nurturing connections and innovating solutions to tackle market challenges head-on. If you thrive on customer satisfaction and turning ideas into reality, then you’ve found your ideal destination. Are you ready to embark on this exciting journey with us?
     
    We make things happen
    We act decisively and with purpose, going the extra mile.
     
    We build together
    We foster relationships and develop creative solutions to address market challenges.
     
    We are here to help
    We are accessible and supportive to colleagues and clients with a friendly approach.
     
     
    Our People Pledge
     
    Don’t meet every single requirement? Research shows that women and people of color are less likely than others to apply if they feel like they don’t match 100% of the job requirements. Don’t let the confidence gap stand in your way, we’d love to hear from you! We understand that experience comes in many different forms and are dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.
     
    Kpler is committed to providing a fair, inclusive and diverse work-environment. We believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, and better ideas allow us to better understand the needs and interests of our diverse, global community. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives and are an equal opportunity employer.
     
     
     
    By applying, I confirm that I have read and accept the Staff Privacy Notice

title: Business Development Representative Intern
salary_basis: Based on historical internship stipend records at Akur8
description_html:
Akur8 is a fast-growing InsurTech scale-up on a mission to modernize how insurers assess, price, and manage risk.

Our next-generation SaaS platform combines transparent machine learning, predictive analytics, and smart product design to turn complex insurance workflows into scalable, data-driven systems.

Powered by expert engineering, data, product, and actuarial teams, Akur8 enables insurers to model risk up to 10x faster while maintaining transparency, explainability, and regulatory trust.

As our product suite expands, we are building an end-to-end platform supporting pricing, reserving, and forward-looking risk decisions — helping insurers operate efficiently in a complex environment.

Recognized globally, Akur8 has been featured in:

  • CB Insights’ Insurtech 50 (2025)

  • CNBC’s InsurTech Top 150 (2025)

  • InsurTech100 Global Insurtech Top 100 (2025)

  • Professional Equality Index 97/100 (2025)

With 40+ nationalities across 8 global offices, we serve 320+ clients across 4 continents while maintaining a strong engineering and product culture.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer, fostering an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives help shape better products and decisions.

As Akur8 continues to grow, we are looking for a Business Development Representative Intern to support our Sales team in identifying relevant prospects and creating new conversations with insurance professionals.

You will join an international Sales team focused on growing Akur8’s client base through new business, account development, and long-term relationships. You will work closely with Sales Directors, Sales Executives Marketing, Sales Operations, and our Actuarial experts. This internship will give you practical experience in B2B SaaS sales, prospecting, and the insurance technology market.

Your mission will include, but not be limited to, the following:

PROSPECT RESEARCH

• Identify insurance companies, reinsurers, brokers, and other relevant organisations that may benefit from Akur8’s solutions.

• Research target accounts, their business priorities, and the people involved in pricing, reserving, actuarial, data, and innovation projects.

• Build and maintain clear account lists to support focused outreach.

OUTBOUND BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

• Write personalised email and LinkedIn messages that speak to each prospect’s role and business context.

• Support outbound calling and follow-up campaigns with guidance from experienced sales colleagues.

• Test different messages, channels, and approaches, then share what you learn with the team.

LEAD QUALIFICATION AND HANDOFF

• Engage with prospects to understand their current processes, challenges, priorities, and potential timelines.

• Qualify early conversations against agreed criteria and identify relevant next steps.

• Schedule meetings for Account Executives and prepare clear handover notes so that each conversation starts with useful context.

SALES AND MARKETING COLLABORATION

• Work with Marketing on campaigns, webinars, events, and content aimed at insurance professionals.

• Share feedback from prospects to help improve messaging and campaign targeting.

• Support the Sales team with account mapping, event preparation, and follow-up activities.

• Support the preparation of client-facing slides and materials, review documents created by the team, and adapt content to address specific client needs.

CRM AND REPORTING

• Keep prospect and activity information accurate in the CRM.

• Track outreach, responses, meetings, and follow-up actions.

• Prepare simple activity reports and contribute ideas to improve the team’s day-to-day sales process.

You will be based in Paris and will work primarily from our office. Occasional travel may be required for team meetings, events, or conferences.

We are looking for someone who is curious about business, comfortable speaking with new people, and ready to learn through practice.

EDUCATIONAL / PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

• You are currently enrolled in a Business School, university, or equivalent programme and are looking for a full-time 6-month internship, with a starting date between October and December.

• You are interested in B2B sales, technology, insurance, or a role that combines business conversations with analytical thinking.

• You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and you are comfortable adapting your message to different audiences.

• You are organized, persistent, and able to manage several follow-up tasks without losing track of details.

• You take initiative, ask thoughtful questions, and respond well to feedback.

• You enjoy working with colleagues from different countries and functions.

• You have strong spoken and written English & French. Additional language is a bonus.

BONUS SKILLS / EXPERIENCE

• A first experience in sales, business development, customer service, or another role involving outreach.

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer – EO/IR Gimbal Systems (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Quantum-Systems GmbH
description_html:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Embedded Software Engineer to lead the development of software for next-generation defense-grade Electro-Optical/Infrared (EO/IR) gimbal systems. The successful candidate will architect and develop high-performance, low-latency video processing and streaming software for embedded computing platforms while integrating cameras, sensors, communication interfaces, and embedded hardware into a mission-critical stabilization and targeting system.

This role requires strong expertise in embedded Linux, multimedia frameworks, GPU-accelerated computing, networking, and hardware/software integration. You will collaborate closely with systems, electronics, computer vision, mechanical, and control engineers to deliver robust, production-ready solutions for demanding defense applications.



What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Design, develop, and maintain embedded software for defense-grade EO/IR gimbal systems.

  • Develop real-time video capture, processing, encoding, decoding, recording, and streaming applications on embedded Linux platforms using GStreamer, FFmpeg, and hardware-accelerated multimedia frameworks.

  • Develop reliable networking solutions for real-time video transport using RTP, RTSP, UDP, TCP, H.264, and H.265.

  • Develop high-performance image processing and computer vision applications using CUDA, OpenCV, or equivalent GPU-accelerated technologies where applicable.

  • Integrate visible, infrared, and thermal imaging sensors into embedded systems.

  • Develop software interfaces for IMUs, laser rangefinders, and other mission-critical sensors.

  • Develop Linux device drivers and perform kernel-level integration for custom hardware.

  • Interface with embedded hardware using SPI, I²C, UART, CAN, GPIO, USB, Ethernet, MIPI CSI, HDMI, and other industry-standard interfaces.

  • Optimize software for deterministic performance, low latency, and efficient utilization of CPU, GPU, and hardware accelerators.

  • Design scalable communication architectures between embedded processors, payload controllers, flight controllers, and external systems.

  • Support hardware bring-up, integration, debugging, verification, and field testing.

  • Implement logging features and analyze issues reported by testing and customers

  • Produce software architecture documentation, interface specifications, and technical documentation.

  • Participate in system architecture, design reviews, and technology roadmap planning.



What you bring to the team:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Robotics, or a related discipline.

  • 5+ years of professional experience developing embedded software for Linux-based systems.

  • Strong expertise in Embedded Linux application development.

  • Experience with Linux kernel development, device drivers, and hardware abstraction layers.

  • Strong C/C++ and/or Rust programming skills.

  • Experience with GStreamer and/or FFmpeg multimedia frameworks for low-latency, high-performance multimedia and video streaming applications.

  • Experience with H.264/H.265 video codecs and streaming technologies including RTSP, RTP, UDP, and TCP.

  • Experience integrating embedded peripherals using SPI, UART, I²C, CAN, GPIO, USB, Ethernet, and similar interfaces.

  • Experience integrating imaging sensors and peripherals such as IMUs, GPS, encoders, or similar devices.

  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals and troubleshooting in embedded or distributed systems.

  • Experience with hardware/software integration and embedded system debugging.

  • Familiarity with GPU computing, OpenCV, CUDA, or equivalent hardware acceleration technologies.

  • Experience with Git, CMake, cross-compilation, and embedded Linux development workflows.

  • Strong systems thinking with an understanding of software architecture and hardware/software interface design.

title: Chief Engineer Autonomous Trucking (m/f/d)
description_html:
Join Quantum-Systems and bring autonomous trucks into real-world operations. As Chief Engineer Autonomous Trucking, you are the technical owner of the entire program and you identify yourself with the success of this product: you set the technical direction, shape the system architecture, and turn customer needs into an integrated, executable delivery plan. You orchestrate the complete system, from base vehicle and autonomy hardware to the autonomy software stack and full system integration, and you drive it to maturity, primarily for defense logistics applications in regulated environments.

You work in an extremely tight partnership with Product Management: they own what the customer needs, you own how we achieve it technically and by when we deliver. Together you balance product ambition against engineering reality, make trade-offs consciously, and keep one integrated plan that the whole organization can execute against.

This is a senior individual contributor role with maximum leverage: you align workstream leads, domain experts, truck OEM partners, and central functions into one integrated product and one executable delivery plan. You are the technical counterpart to Product, Sales, Supply Chain, Operations, external stakeholder (OEMs), and the credible engineering voice towards senior leadership.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Own the Technical Program

    • Own the end-to-end technical orchestration of our autonomous trucking program with strong focus on integration, execution readiness, and delivery reliability.

    • Define and maintain the integrated technical roadmap: milestones, dependencies, and critical path from development through deployment, performance, and certification goals.

    • Identify integration gaps, decision bottlenecks, and execution risks early; escalate with judgement and propose solution options

    • Ensure technical trade-offs are transparent and made consciously across product, engineering, and operations.

  • Drive System Integration to series industrialisation and production

    • Align technical integration and ensure convergence across base vehicle, autonomy hardware stack, autonomy software stack (modular and End2End planner approaches), verification and validation, ground operations and test, and systems engineering including safety and security.

    • Drive technical maturity from subsystem status to validated system behavior; ensure interfaces are clear, owned, and validated between the teams

    • Push for integration planning with the right cadence of reviews, demos, test evidence, and decision points.

  • Partner with Product Management

    • Work in an extremely tight loop with Product Management: they own what the customer needs, you own how and by when we deliver it in lockstep alignment with engineering management.

    • Translate product intent into technical execution clarity; challenge unclear scope, unclear priorities, or missing system implications early.

    • Shape realistic sequencing between product ambition and engineering capacity.

    • Build trusted, eye-level working relationships with truck OEM engineering teams and manage the joint technical interfaces, handovers, and delivery commitments.

    • Act as the strong technical counterpart to Sales, Supply Chain, and Operations: connect program needs with sourcing timelines, service concepts, and operational readiness.

    • Create alignment across internal engineering teams and domains on priorities, interfaces, and expected delivery contributions.

  • Be a Senior Technical Leader

    • Operate with high autonomy and high judgement; represent the technical program in reviews up to C-level.

    • Be a calm, credible, and sharp voice in high-stakes discussions, internally and towards partners and customers.

    • Raise the bar on accountability, collaboration, and delivery discipline across workstream leads and domain experts, without creating unnecessary process overhead.



What you bring to the team:

  • Engineering degree in a relevant field (e.g. Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, Robotics, or comparable).

  • 10+ years of experience in autonomous driving or field robotics, ideally with several years in autonomous trucking.

  • Outstanding technical depth across the full autonomous driving system: autonomy software (perception, planning, control, end to end planner architectures), autonomy hardware (compute, sensors, user interfaces), base vehicle hardware architecture, and system integration.

  • Proven experience delivering complex systems in regulated environments; defense background is a strong plus but not mandatory.

  • Outstanding technical project and program management skills: roadmapping, critical path management, risk management, and delivery steering of multi-team workstreams.

  • Track record of working with vehicle OEMs, ideally truck OEMs, on joint development and integration programs.

  • Outstanding communication skills: condensate complex technical discussions into actionable items per team.

  • Systems thinker: you think in milestones and integration maturity, not in isolated component optimization.

  • Fluent in English; German is a strong plus.

  • High ownership, pragmatic, hands-on mindset; willingness to travel to OEM, partner, and test sites.

Your Benefits: 

  • Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles. 

  • Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities. 

  • Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life. 

  • Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget. 

  • Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities.

salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Auxmoney Gmbh
description_html:
Dein neues Team:

Du willst verstehen, wie Forderungsverkauf, Partnersteuerung und saubere Prozesskontrollen in der Praxis zusammenspielen? Im Bereich NPL & Partnermanagement verantworten wir die operativen Abläufe rund um den Forderungsverkauf und die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Partnern. Dabei sorgen wir dafür, dass unsere NPL- und Partnerprozesse zuverlässig, datenbasiert und revisionssicher dokumentiert laufen. Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) unterstützt Du uns im Tagesgeschäft und arbeitest eng mit internen Schnittstellen sowie externen Partnern zusammen.


Das erwartet Dich:

  • Monitoring & IKS: Du unterstützt beim Monitoring laufender NPL- und Partnerprozesse sowie bei monatlichen IKS-Kontrollen und dokumentierst Nachweise nachvollziehbar in unseren internen Systemen.
  • Zahlungsverbuchung & Reporting: Du spielst Zahlungen in unsere interne Inkasso-Software ein, führst Kontrollen und Abgleiche durch und erstellst Zahlungsberichte.
  • Datenchecks & Abgleiche: Du führst vordefinierte SQL-Checks aus, passt diese bei Bedarf minimal an und erstellst Grundgesamtheiten inklusive CSV-Exporten sowie Duplikats-, Schnittmengen- und Plausibilitätsprüfungen.
  • Forderungsverkauf & Rückabwicklung: Du unterstützt bei der Vorbereitung und operativen Abwicklung von Forderungsverkäufen an Debt Collection Agencies (DCAs), bearbeitest definierte Sonderfälle, begleitest Prozess- und Dateitransfers und dokumentierst Vorgänge sauber im Ticket-System.
  • Partnerabstimmung & Nachverfolgung: Du stimmst Dich mit unserer Partnerbank SWK, den DCAs sowie intern mit IT ab, klärst Rückfragen und hältst offene Punkte konsequent nach.
  • DCA-Statistiken & Präsentation: Du bereitest DCA-Statistiken auf und unterstützt bei deren Vorstellung.
  • Maximale Flexibilität: Du arbeitest hybrid mit einem festen Präsenztag pro Woche in Düsseldorf und ansonsten im Homeoffice innerhalb Deutschlands.


Das bringst Du mit:

  • Studium: Du bist aktuell in einem Studium der BWL, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder in einem vergleichbaren Studiengang eingeschrieben.
  • Erste Praxiserfahrung: Du hast erste Erfahrung im Umgang mit Daten, Reports oder operativen Abläufen gesammelt, zum Beispiel durch Praktika, eine Werkstudierendentätigkeit oder eine Ausbildung, und idealerweise bringst Du erste SQL-Kenntnisse mit.
  • Struktur & Sorgfalt: Du arbeitest zuverlässig, sorgfältig und strukturiert und übernimmst Aufgaben eigenständig.
  • Datenaffinität: Du hast Freude an Zahlen, Tabellen und Listen und ein gutes Verständnis für Abgleiche und Plausibilitätsprüfungen.
  • Tool-Sicherheit: Du verfügst über sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse, insbesondere in Excel, und findest Dich schnell in neuen Systemen zurecht.
  • Kommunikation: Du bereitest Themen klar und übersichtlich auf und kommunizierst gerne mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartnerinnen und Ansprechpartner.
  • Sprachen: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.


Das bringen wir mit:

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Gestalte Deinen Arbeitstag so, dass er optimal zu Deinem Studium passt – wir unterstützen Deine individuellen Bedürfnisse!
  • Möglichkeit zur Arbeit im Homeoffice: Arbeite dort, wo Du Dich am wohlsten fühlst. Ob im Büro oder von zu Hause – Du entscheidest!
  • Flache Hierarchien: Bei uns wird Teamarbeit großgeschrieben! Du hast direkten Kontakt zu Entscheidungsträgern und kannst Deine Ideen einbringen.
  • Vielfältige Gestaltungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Du hast die Chance, Deine eigenen Projekte zu leiten und Deine Fähigkeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Zahlreiche bereichsübergreifende Events: Knüpfe wertvolle Kontakte und erlebe unser Team bei spannenden Veranstaltungen und Teamevents.
  • Vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Fitness First oder Urban Sports Club: Bleib fit und gesund – wir fördern Dein Wohlbefinden mit attraktiven Fitnessangeboten!
  • Täglich frisches Obst, endlos Kaffee, Tee und Wasser: Genieße eine gesunde Snack- und Getränkebar, die Dir hilft, energisch durch den Tag zu kommen.
  • Rabatte über Corporate Benefits: Profitiere von exklusiven Angeboten und Rabatten auf zahlreiche Produkte und Dienstleistungen – ein zusätzliches Plus für Deinen Geldbeutel!
Schließe Dich unserem Team an und bewirb Dich noch heute! Vergiss nicht, uns Dein voraussichtliches Ende des Studiums, Deinen gewünschten Stundenlohn sowie Dein nächstmögliches Startdatum mitzuteilen. Wir freuen uns darauf, Deine Bewerbung zu erhalten!

Für uns als Arbeitgeber sind Chancengleichheit und Diversität besonders wichtig. Daher freuen wir uns auf Bewerbungen von Müttern, Vätern, Menschen mit Behinderungen und Menschen aus der LGBTQIA+ Community. Bitte teile uns gerne mit, wenn wir z.B. ein geschlechtsneutrales Pronomen verwenden sollen, Du einen barrierefreien Zugang zu unserem Büro benötigst oder wir mehr Zeit für den Bewerbungsprozess einplanen sollen.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Auxmoney Gmbh
description_html:
Your new team:

Would you like to build Salesforce solutions that directly improve the experience of thousands of customers? At auxmoney, you will join a dynamic, cross functional team with a strong focus on customer satisfaction and a 360 degree view of the customer journey. You will work at the intersection of tech, product, and business, shaping scalable platform capabilities and reliable workflows that support one of Europe’s leading fintech platforms.


What you can expect:

  • Own end to end delivery: You architect, implement, and maintain high quality Salesforce solutions across Apex, Flows, LWC, and data models, and you take technical ownership from design to release.
  • Build strong architectures: You apply clean architecture, testability, and performance best practices, and you raise the bar for maintainable code across the platform.
  • Deliver great Salesforce UX: You design and optimize Lightning Web Components with strong performance, thoughtful interaction patterns, and a focus on usable, scalable experiences.
  • Secure by design: You implement robust security and sharing concepts aligned with Salesforce’s security model, including profiles, permission sets, role hierarchy, sharing rules, and field level security.
  • Integrate with confidence: You design and implement integrations via REST and SOAP, platform events, and connectors with resilient patterns, strong authentication, and thorough error handling.
  • Optimize for scale: You build within Salesforce governor limits and enforce best practices for bulkification, caching, transaction management, and async processing.
  • Raise engineering standards: You define and champion platform standards, coding conventions, code reviews, and design guidelines as a trusted technical authority.
  • Mentor and multiply impact: You coach junior and mid level developers through pair programming, structured knowledge sharing, and pragmatic guidance that improves team output.
  • Partner across stakeholders: You collaborate closely with Product, Data, and Operations to translate complex business needs into scalable technical designs and delivery plans.
  • Test for trust: You set expectations for meaningful unit and integration testing, and you help the team maintain strong, reliable coverage that supports safe delivery.
  • Keep the platform reliable: You strengthen observability and maintainability through documentation, architectural decision records, and practical knowledge sharing.
  • Work setup: You will work remotely within Germany, with collaboration routines that keep delivery fast, aligned, and transparent.


Your profile

  • Seasoned Salesforce development: You bring extensive hands on Salesforce development experience (8+ years) in enterprise environments and a track record of delivering impact at scale.
  • Technical leadership: You are advanced in Flows and highly proficient in Apex and OOP, and you confidently choose the right approach across Flow, Apex, and configuration.
  • Strong LWC expertise: You have deep experience with Lightning Web Components, including lifecycle, reactivity, performance optimization, and UI and UX best practices.
  • Security and compliance mindset: You understand Salesforce’s security and sharing model and design for least privilege from the start.
  • Integration skills: You connect Salesforce to external systems via REST and SOAP, OAuth, and named or external credentials, and you select suitable integration patterns for complex scenarios.
  • Built for scale: You consistently apply best practices in governor limits, bulkification, transactions, async processing, and error handling, and you help others do the same.
  • Delivery discipline: You work fluently with Git and pull requests, and you have hands on experience with CI and CD for Salesforce, for example Salesforce DX and GitHub Actions.
  • Clear communication: You communicate technical concepts clearly in English and collaborate effectively in cross functional teams.
  • Nice to have: You bring German skills, Salesforce certifications such as PD I or PD II, Architect track progress, and experience with managed packages, platform events, and Data Loader or ETL.


What we offer:

  • Flexibility for Your Lifestyle: Enjoy family-friendly working hours and a generous home office policy, allowing you to stay agile and flexible in any situation.
  • Ergonomic Work Environment: For your office days, we provide ergonomic workstations that offer you a comfortable and healthy workspace.
  • Independent Work: With short decision-making paths, we enable you to work autonomously and actively contribute your ideas – we provide space for you to take on responsibility.
  • Grow with Us: Unlock your potential with numerous opportunities for growth and development, along with an annual development budget to help you achieve your professional and personal goals.
  • Team Spirit: Team spirit is important to us – we regularly host events and parties where fun is guaranteed.
  • Mobility Your Way: Whether you prefer a train ticket or parking – we support your choice of preferred mobility.
  • Stay Active: Keep fit with a discounted membership at Fitness First or Urban Sports Club, or use our in-house fitness room to stay active after work and enhance your work-life balance.
  • Secure Your Future: Think about your future – we offer subsidies for company pension plans so you can plan long-term with us.
  • Tailored Benefits: We consider your personal life situation – whether you're a parent or love to travel, we offer customized benefits to suit your lifestyle.
Your perspective: You will shape how auxmoney builds and scales its Salesforce platform by owning end to end delivery and influencing technical standards. Your work will directly improve reliability, speed, and quality across customer facing and operational processes. You will grow your impact through mentoring and by helping define future architecture decisions.

At auxmoney, we’re committed to equal opportunity and diversity. We especially welcome applications from parents, people with disabilities, and members of the LGBTQIA+ community. Please feel free to let us know if you’d like us to use gender-neutral pronouns, if you need barrier-free access to our office, or if you require more time during the application process.

title: Strategic Account Executive (m/f/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at DocuWare
description_html:
Why should you join?

DocuWare stands for globally distributed, international teams and an open corporate culture that invites you to help shape it. Mobile Work and flexible working hours are part of our everyday life. Would you like to be part of an innovative company whose solutions are digitizing everyday work in a wide range of industries? In that case, we are happy to welcome you to the team.


Your Responsibilities

As Strategic Account Executive (m/f/d), you are responsible for sustainably expanding the structure of the Authorized DocuWare Partner (ADP) network and supporting DocuWare software sales. In this role, you implement the solution selling approach and promote these strategies within the partner network.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Meeting or exceeding sales quotas established during target-setting discussions and by management.
  • Developing business opportunities via the partner channel, including creating and implementing marketing plans and collaborating with other departments to identify new business prospects.
  • Actively supporting our partners with lead qualification and leveraging your own closing skills to help secure partner deals.
  • Conducting sales workshops, training sessions, end-user webinars, and customer presentations to educate partners and close deals.
  • Acquiring new partners and expanding the partner network.
  • Handling monthly administrative tasks (such as CRM updates and report uploads) and communicating the results to management.
  • Demonstrating your sales expertise by identifying opportunities and independently managing them from initial contact and the pre-sales phase through to a successful close.


What you need to succeed

  • You have several years of professional experience in sales - specifically with document management, business, accounting, or ERP software. DocuWare certifications are a plus.
  • You possess strong presentation and communication skills when interacting with customers, sales staff, and various other stakeholders.
  • You have excellent IT skills and the ability to competently demonstrate software functions and their benefits.
  • Your skillset also includes analyzing business processes and identifying tailored solutions.
  • Furthermore, you have excellent verbal and written German skills. A very high level of proficiency in spoken and written English rounds out your profile.
  • A high willingness to travel is required. You also enjoy leading and motivating people.


What we can offer

There are many great reasons to join DocuWare - our company culture is only one of them.
 As part of the DocuWare team, you will benefit from many advantages:

  • Globally distributed, international teams: You will find our teams working in Germering, New York, Sofia or other worldwide locations.
  • Flexible work location and hours: You work hybrid - on the road or in our modern office - and you have the flexibility to arrange your own working hours.
  • Individual support: After an intensive induction, you will receive regular training tailored to your needs (e.g. conferences internal team building measures).
  • Well-earned rest: 35 vacation days per year, sport offerings, massages, a football table and a relaxing lounge area.
  • Mental health support: With our employee assistance program you have free and confidential access to resources and support for your well-being and stress management at any time.
  • Healthy food: Together we enjoy Fairtrade coffee with organic milk or oat milk, snacks and fresh fruit - all free of charge - as well as subsidized lunch from the Foodji fridge.
  • Free Tuesday Lunch: Every Tuesday, enjoy a complimentary and varied lunch.
  • Good accessibility: Choose how you would like to come to the office with a leased e-bike, by train or via highways A96/A99 (you can charge your e-car on site for free).
  • Team spirit: Regular employee and team events (virtual or on-site) ensure excellent collaboration with colleagues around the world.
  • Sustainability and social commitment: DocuWare stands for paperless work and supports volunteer organizations and local sports clubs.
  • Planning for your future: DocuWare subsidizes your company pension plan!
  • We offer a stable job with a well established and growing company.
  • Unique benefits: Choose one of three great options (Bonago, E-Gym or subsidized Deutschlandticket) to suit your needs.
  • We only use the latest technologies - find out more on Stackshare.
  • Up to 30 Days Work from Abroad: Experience international opportunities and broaden your horizons.
  • Family First: Preferential registration in our selected daycare center in Germering (no guarantee).
  • Buddy Program: You'll be paired with a buddy, who will support you during your onboarding and offer valuable tips.
For better insights, check us out on Instagram!

Sarah Jagenow
Recruiting & Employer Branding Specialist

title: Head of Business Operations / Senior Business Operations Manager - all genders welcome!
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at Vicegolf
description_html:
About the Job

Join us in reshaping the future of golf! With a team of over 85 passionate people, we're dedicated to our mission in revolutionizing the golf industry one swing at a time. Our international team, based in Munich, is seeking a motivated Head of Business Operations or Senior Business Operations Manager to become part of our company in a dynamic and innovative environment. In this role, you help translate our revenue targets into an operational plan and bring five independent teams together along this plan. You are the central interface for planning, timing, and alignment in the revenue and marketing area, holding everything together. Ready to embrace your Vice?


Skip the copy paste. Show us your swing

Your CV tells us what you’ve done. We want to understand why those experiences make you the right person for this role. So make your application your own: tailor your CV, tell us about your most relevant achievement, or surprise us with a short presentation. This isn’t a design contest, we’re interested in how you think, what you bring to the table, and what you want to achieve at Vice.


Your Fairway

  • Break down monthly and quarterly D2C targets into weekly and daily targets with specific references to products and promotional campaigns
  • Develop target proposals for C-level executives, who will approve the final plan
  • Maintain the product and promotional calendar, taking processes and deadlines into account
  • Ensuring lead times across five teams (E-commerce & UX, CRM, Performance Marketing, Brand & Marketing, Tech) and identifying and resolving deviations early on
  • Leading the weekly trading review
  • Analyzing problems and developing solutions together with the teams
  • Supporting the expansion of planning to additional sales channels (Green Grass, Specialty Retail, Amazon, etc.)
  • Making independent decisions regarding promotional calendars, discounts, and team prioritization; final decisions regarding budget, pricing, and P&L remain the responsibility of our C-level


Your Scorecard

  • Commercial numerical understanding and judgment rather than pure reporting of numbers

  • Fluency in spoken and written German and English

  • Several years of professional experience (3+ years) in business operations, consulting, chief of staff, commercial, and program management, or comparable experience in complex organizational areas is preferred

  • A background in performance marketing, content, or e-commerce technology is an asset but not a requirement

  • Organizational talent to bring five teams together, identify dependencies early on, and ensure alignment before a gap turns into a problem

  • Critical mindset to challenge the status quo, contribute your own ideas, and actively help shape the future rather than just following plans

  • Structured thinking with foresight

  • Strong communication skills to convince experienced team leads on an equal footing and think creatively with them about the future, while still giving them the space to apply their technical expertise

  • A passion for golf is a plus, but not a requirement 


Note: We use Artificial Intelligence to support this process; the final decision still remains with a human.


Our Clubhouse

  • We embrace diversity and innovation. Our motley team comes from all backgrounds and perspectives, united by fresh and bold ideas.

  • Taking ownership from day one. Our ambitious vision relies on every individual stepping up to bring Vice Golf to the next level.

  • Make your work hours fit your life. Flexible work arrangements and remote work options cater to your work-life balance.

  • Grow with us. We place great emphasis on your personal development, where you benefit from not only regular performance feedback but also an annual training budget.

  • Escape the routine. Within the EU, you’re free to choose your workspace for two weeks a year.

  • Stay active. We’re invested in your well-being, subsidizing EGYM Wellpass so you can train for only 30 € a month.

  • Enjoy! Fuel your day with a varied selection of fresh meals and snacks from our Foodji.

  • Secure your (far) future! While retirement might seem distant to you, we’ve got you covered with options to enroll in our corporate pension plan.

  • Work hard play hard. Work on your golf skills and refine your swing on the state-of-the-art golf simulator and putting green in our office.

  • Enjoy the open bar. Have some Afterwork drinks on our rooftop while enjoying the view of the Alps.

title: Product Owner (all genders) - Management Suite Tribe
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Baramundi Software Ag
description_html:
Welcome to baramundi!

“Where security, automation and centralized control come together, modern endpoint management begins.”

Do you want to actively shape modern UEM solutions, translate technical complexity into clear product decisions and create real value for IT administrators together with strong development teams? Then become part of our Management Suite Tribe and help drive the further development of our primarily on-premise Unified Endpoint Management solution as a Product Owner.

At baramundi, we develop software solutions that enable companies to centrally manage, secure and automate their endpoints. As a Product Owner, you work closely with development, Product Management, Support, Consulting and our customers in an agile, interdisciplinary environment. Your goal: to translate product requirements into valuable, prioritized and actionable features.


Do what you do best:

  • DRIVE PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT IN THE MANAGEMENT SUITE TRIBE You take content responsibility for two development squads and, together with them, further develop key product areas of the baramundi Management Suite, primarily in Windows Endpoint Management – from fundamental client-server communication to compliance and defense management, Windows OS installation, co-management and Windows Update Management. You are part of the Product Owner Chapter and work closely within the leadership trio of Chapter Lead, Scrum Master and Product Owner.
  • TRANSLATE REQUIREMENTS INTO CLEAR PRODUCT INCREMENTS You understand technical and functional complexity, formulate features and product backlog items precisely and ensure clear, testable acceptance criteria. You prioritize the product backlog based on customer value, effort, dependencies and stakeholder input.
  • DELIVER WITH YOUR TEAMS You are the primary contact person for content-related and product-related questions from your development teams, make progress transparent and ensure that your squads can work in a focused, informed and empowered way. At the same time, you balance maintenance, quality and new features.
  • BE THE BRIDGE BETWEEN PRODUCT, DEVELOPMENT AND STAKEHOLDERS You work closely with Product Management, Support, Consulting, customers as well as internal and external development partners, actively gather feedback and translate requirements into concrete development steps. In doing so, you represent product value just as clearly as the perspective of your teams.
  • COORDINATE EXTERNAL PROJECTS AND DEVELOPMENT SERVICES You coordinate external teams and projects from a content perspective, ensure clear requirements, transparent alignment and reliable integration into product development.
  • USE AI MEANINGFULLY IN YOUR PRODUCT OWNER ROUTINE You use AI tools in a reflective and pragmatic way – for example when creating features and PBIs, structuring requirements or developing quick prototypes for stakeholder feedback.


What we appreciate about you:

  • Several years of experience as a Product Owner or in a comparable role with product responsibility in an agile software development environment.
  • Experience in providing content leadership for multiple development teams as well as integrating and coordinating external projects or developers.
  • Confidence working with Scrum, Kanban and backlog tools – ideally Azure DevOps – as well as experience in scaled agile ways of working.
  • Solid knowledge of or strong interest in Unified Endpoint Management, Client Lifecycle Management and Windows-based IT infrastructures.
  • Ability to quickly understand technical complexity and translate it into clear, prioritizable requirements.
  • Analytical, data-based decision-making and a high standard of quality.
  • Strong communication skills in German and English and enjoyment in working with different stakeholders.
  • Ability to provide content leadership at eye level, create orientation and foster open, transparent exchange within the team.
  • Bonus: background in IT administration, practical knowledge of software development, experience with the Azure technology stack or touchpoints with Linux, macOS, Android or iOS.


Meet us!


10 reasons to choose baramundi!

#1 ARRIVE IN PEACE
Our all-inclusive package makes starting particularly easy. Your personal onboarding buddy will show you everything: from the welcome breakfast to the fully equipped workplace.

#2 FEEL AT HOME
Coffee, fruit, and drinks are free. We take care of your mail and packages. Once a month, all baramundians meet during work hours for pizza and chatting. Just because.

#3 EXPERIENCE VALUE AND APPRECIATION
We believe in values and live them: togetherness and trust. Courage, enthusiasm, and competence. Our communication culture is open and honest. Just like the regular team feedback sessions.

#4 GET REWARDED
You will also feel our appreciation. Success bonuses are as natural as Christmas bonuses, company pension plans, and team events.

#5 ENJOY LIFE
Work time is life time. That’s why you can organize it individually with us. With flexible working hours in full or part-time, home office, and even sabbatical options.

#6 STAY HEALTHY
We want you to feel good. That’s why we have ergonomic furniture and organize health days, massages, yoga, and running groups.

#7 DEVELOP FURTHER
Your personal and professional advancement is important to us. We pay for training and coaching during working hours. Even two-year work stays at our branch in the USA are possible.

#8 WORK AT EYE LEVEL
We are all on a first-name basis, from apprentices to management. We don’t have complicated hierarchies.

#9 YOUR FAMILY IS IMPORTANT TO US
Family means being there, caring, and supporting each other. We do this with daycare subsidies and holiday care, as well as at our family summer festival.

#10 MAKE US EVEN BETTER
We want to be a great place and employer. For that, we need honest feedback.


Contact us!
